evidence: PDF pp.3–8 Figures 1–3, Table 1, Algorithm 1: L1 reference-free heuristics, L2 reference-dependent transport and L3 schema-dependent irreversible-action gate; online artifact-string extraction can miss semantic/shell-resolved dependencies. Generated reference skeletons cannot authorize automatic halts.

PDF pp.5–9 Eqs.2–10 and Proposition 1: fixed node mass, frontier masking, one warm-start CG step and escalation; implementation clips the GW gradient and reports an L1 mass surrogate. Final equality requires matching online/batch graphs and identical cold-start solver inputs, not exact minimization or global optimality. The .013 discrepancy is against eventual finalization, not same-prefix tracking error.

PDF pp.9–10 Tables 2–3: eight designed scenarios pass; a prior stale-frontier bug blocked 50/50 valid calls, then 0/50 after repair (95% upper bound about 6%). SWE-agent has no irreversible-annotated tools, so L3 does not run there. No-schema/no-reference policy is allow-by-default, not a safety guarantee.

PDF p.10 Table 4: full system hallucination/inversion detection 12/30 each with 13/40 benign traces flagged; no-GW 21/30 and 25/30 with 29/40 flagged. No-mask changes benign count only to 14/40. Released-sweep claims put hallucination/inversion AUPRC .44–.47 near .45 base rate for all variants, so the lower false-alarm point is not curve-level dominance.

PDF p.11 Section 6.2: 2,294 traces, 2,288 usable (430 resolved/1,858 unresolved), six malformed excluded; 228 calibration instances, five reference instances, remaining evaluation, seed42; one trace per instance. all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and calibration-selected lambda=.3 are frozen.

PDF p.11 Table 5: at k=8 OnTrack .631 versus cosine .574, difference .057 [95% CI .033,.080]; by k=15 difference .002 [-.022,.027]. LinUOT is .628 at k=8. Reviewer inference: n_steps AUROC .622 at k=5 cannot arise from a constant five-step prefix count under the stated fixed-k protocol; use of another length variable or full future length needs clarification, not an assumption of verified online availability.

PDF p.12 Table 6: threshold .60 gives 23.3% unresolved stops, 20.7% resolved false stops and author-reported 17.9% failed-population cost savings on 150+150 profiles. Precision83% is adjusted to an81%-unresolved corpus. Threshold .60 is explicitly selected for exposition after the sweep; fixed-FPR rates are evaluation ROC readouts, not pre-registered deployment thresholds. Rival cutoffs match or exceed savings at some matched false-stop rates.

PDF pp.12–13: authors explicitly state the data log only per-trace, not per-step cost, and remaining-step fraction does not license dollar conversion; a precise cost allocation for Table6 is not supplied. Thus savings are an author-reported replay estimate, not directly measured intervention-time billing savings. Median detection at58.6% of cost-limit trace steps is not58.6% of dollars.

PDF pp.13–14 Tables7–8: cost-limit AUROC .979 matches step count .978; real three-step splice score AUROC .546 and leakage p=.93; length-matched outcome AUROC .526 versus cosine .540. Controlled hallucination success does not transfer to general real-trace semantic error detection.

PDF pp.15–16 AppendixA/Table9: five seeds resample evaluation traces with partition, references and lambda fixed. Reviewer inference: class prevalence alone does not systematically alter AUROC, so the table caption's attribution of higher AUROC to class balancing is not generally valid; finite-sample selection can vary estimates. These are not five independent training or split replications.

PDF pp.9–10: fast-path p50 .85ms/p95 1.6ms at t=m40,K3 on an Apple M5 Max core; escalated solve approximately30ms, and no demonstrated long-horizon compression. End-to-end embedding/extraction overhead is not separately characterized.

Complete PDF pp.1–16 and retained official abs.html: full methods, references and AppendixA present; external code/config/result JSON release is claimed without a concrete repository link identified in the inspected source. No external artifact or author code was executed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant engineering research with useful architectural separation and unusually explicit negative findings. The most defensible result is an early alignment advantage over cosine on replayed SWE-agent traces, not superior general hallucination detection or safe autonomous stopping. GW mainly changes the shipped operating point; matched PR curves and ranking do not establish dominance. Prefix-fixed step-count discrimination is an unresolved protocol inconsistency, and the corpus has no per-step costs, so claimed compute savings require an accounting assumption that is not adequately specified. A 20.7% successful-run false-stop rate and post-hoc threshold selection materially limit deployment value despite the failure-skewed precision. Batch reduction is to the same implemented clipped-gradient/surrogate solver with identical initialization, not an exact OT optimum or a per-prefix tracking theorem. Complete PDF access supports this bounded assessment; external release and experiment replication were not performed.

primary_link.title: OnTrack: Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention in LLM Agent Trajectories via Streaming Structure-Aware Optimal Transport

papers.summary: Agents are deployed in applications from trip planners and stock trading to IT incident triage. In most cases, LLM agents work autonomously with minimal rule-based safeguarding, leading to cost and safety issues from irreversible actions. Recent works resolve this either by using a safeguard agent to monitor behavior or evaluating logs post-hoc. The first adds cost and latency to every step; the second delivers its verdict after the run, when tokens are burned and damage is done. To overcome this, we propose OnTrack, a streaming monitoring mechanism that compares an agent's steps and dependencies against recorded successful runs to alert users or block the agent in about a millisecond per step. We study this problem in three regimes of decreasing access: full reference access (historical runs and tool schemas), intermediate access (only tool schemas), and no prior knowledge (only step logs as generated). Expectation of OnTrack's monitoring capabilities reduces as data access drops, ranging from plan violation detection to identifying loops, stalls, and repeated tool calls. Finally, we evaluate OnTrack using SWE-bench trajectories. Based on the first 8 steps, our method ranks failing trajectories below succeeding ones better than content similarity approaches (+0.057 AUROC). With an abort policy, we save about 18% of compute that would be burned on failing runs, where 83% of interrupted runs were actually heading to failure (5 out of 6 aborts were correct).
papers.summary_en: OnTrack aligns growing dependency graphs with successful references, combining transport signals with loop heuristics and schema gates. At eight SWE-agent steps it reports AUROC .631 versus cosine .574, but structure adds little ranking value and gains vanish later. The illustrative abort policy saves about 18% on failed runs while stopping about 21% of successes; its 83% precision relies on an 81% failure base rate. Prefix-length and cost-accounting ambiguities, weak real anomaly detection and unverified code limit deployment claims.
papers.summary_zh:
代理在執行中繞圈或偏離計畫時，等整段日誌結束才評分往往太晚。OnTrack 把逐步事件建成相依圖，將已發生的前綴與成功參考軌跡對齊；以可執行前緣遮罩避免處罰尚未做到的步驟，並用暖啟動求解與短暫探索寬限處理延後才出現的依賴。循環與停滯由無參考啟發式偵測，不可逆工具的阻擋則依賴明示工具契約，兩者不能全部歸功於最佳傳輸。

作者重播二千二百八十八條可解析 SWE-agent 軌跡，在前八步得到 AUROC 0.631，比餘弦相似度高 0.057；十五步後差距消失，拿掉結構項也幾乎不改排名。停止策略報告可省失敗群體約十八％成本，但同一設定會誤停約二十一％原本成功的軌跡；八十三％停止精確率依賴語料本就有八十一％失敗，不能讀成高可靠度防護。

完整十六頁、三圖與九表顯示，這較適合作為低延遲流程告警的工程提案。真實軌跡中的幻覺與因果顛倒接近偵測下限，安全閘門未在這批真實工具上觸發。另須留意：固定前綴長度下，步數基線卻有非隨機辨識率，資訊來源未交代；逐步成本也未記錄，節省數字不能當成已量測的帳單節省。停止門檻為事後示例，尚需獨立校準與效用評估；程式釋出聲稱本次未另行驗證。

links.title: Agentic-TTT: Training test-time policy for test-time training

evidence: PDF pp.3–5, Sections 2.1–2.2: ASSIGN, ADAPT, LOAD and GENERATE operate on pools and an evolving LoRA library. Guidance collection retains empirically beneficial prescribed actions, removes hints before SFT, and upweights action tokens by four. RL uses within-state trajectory groups and a capped invalid-action penalty.

PDF pp.4–5 and 25–26, Sections 2.2.2/E: sampled rollouts are rolled back; annotated gold actions advance training state. RL optimizes query-level returns, not Equation 4 over autonomous complete streams. Delayed cross-query credit and exposure bias are expressly left unresolved.

PDF pp.5–6/Table 1: 176 held-out scored queries; Qwen2.5-7B direct utility 0.256, SFT-only 0.375±0.010 and SFT+RL 0.510±0.012. These are means of automatic binary task scores; uncertainty is sample standard deviation across three independent policy-training runs, each checkpoint evaluated once.

PDF p.6/Figure 2: over three runs, 141 incorrect direct answers become correct and seven correct direct answers become incorrect. One hundred reuse decisions help on 61 queries and harm on one. These are aggregate event counts within the selected test stream, not population rates.

PDF pp.7–8/Figures 3–5: the separate FLOP-normalized/log-cost sweep raises direct answering from 11.8% to 39.8% and lowers normalized adaptation compute from 1375.5 to 886.9. This is adaptation-cost control, not an end-to-end latency, energy or dollar-cost measurement; moderate-penalty means improve but three-seed intervals overlap.

PDF pp.8–9/Table 2: Qwen-14B rises from 0.432 to 0.621 overall, yet Logic Games and Medical QA regress. Llama-8B regresses on Math and Code; GLM-9B on Logic Games and Long-context QA. Positive gains in every domain apply to the primary Qwen-7B experiment, not all backbones.

PDF p.9/Tables 3–4: action-token weighting improves utility 0.464→0.510 and invalid-action rate 4.08%→1.72%; invalid-action penalty improves 0.467→0.510 and budget exhaustion 21.20%→13.33%. These are useful protocol ablations rather than evidence isolating every contribution.

PDF pp.16–17/Table 5: 229 train, 45 development and 176 test questions; 19 unscored document ingestion events make 195 test events. Code scoring adds twelve withheld cases to public tests. Document sources are split at document level, and questions are answered without original document text to study parametric memory, not ordinary contextual QA.

PDF p.17, Appendix B.2: approximately 65% of curated benchmark queries exhibit adaptation benefits; only 35/500 MATH-500 queries (7.0%) satisfy the high-gain reference criterion. This is explicit outcome-based enrichment of both train and test, not a random source-distribution sample.

PDF pp.18–20, Appendices C/D and Tables 6–7: separate rank-16 policy LoRA; final answers disable it and exclude policy traces. Each query has six turns and one successful adaptation, with forced bare-model generation on exhaustion. Pool names include rule-derived domain/format labels, top-eight retrieval uses embeddings plus BM25, and warm-start updates replay up to eight old samples.

PDF pp.18 and 20–25: three-run cached TTT gains are reused during training; uncached 7B training is reported around eleven H200 GPU-hours. Method hyperparameters and system, action, collection and TTT-specific prompts are printed. No author code or independent experiment was executed; exact artifact release and selected-data reconstruction remain unverified.

PDF pp.25–26/E: pseudo-label errors and poisoned adaptation material can propagate through the library. Isolated adapters permit rollback but do not prevent harmful output or reverse downstream effects; adversarial robustness is proposed future work, not demonstrated safety.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A relevant and conceptually useful controller for deciding whether, how and when to reuse test-time adaptation. The measured gain is real as a reported result within a deliberately benefit-enriched, verifier-friendly protocol, with three-run variation and informative counterexamples across backbones. It is not evidence that arbitrary deployment utility doubles: document QA excludes original text at answer time, compute sweeps cover adaptation rather than full system cost, and gold-action stream advancement leaves delayed cross-query credit assignment unresolved. Detailed in-PDF prompts make the idea inspectable; absent artifact-level reproduction and small selected workloads keep the rating calibrated.

The measured gain is real as a reported result within a deliberately benefit-enriched, verifier-friendly protocol, with three-run variation and informative counterexamples across backbones. It is not evidence that arbitrary deployment utility doubles: document QA excludes original text at answer time, compute sweeps cover adaptation rather than full system cost, and gold-action stream advancement leaves delayed cross-query credit assignment unresolved. Detailed in-PDF prompts make the idea inspectable; absent artifact-level reproduction and small selected workloads keep the rating calibrated.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 研究把是否適應、選哪種方法與何時重用技能變成控制器決策，與使用者關心的代理與推論方法高度相關。文中增益是在刻意富集、可自動驗證的評估內成立，且提供三次訓練變異及跨模型反例；不能解讀成任意部署效用倍增。文件問答排除回答時原文、成本掃描主要計適應運算，以及用標註動作推進訓練流，都限制更廣推論，跨題延遲信用分配仍未解決。PDF 的詳細提示有助理解，但未做實體發布驗證與重現，小型選擇性資料也要求保守評分。
llm_evaluation.scope_assessment: In scope: language-model adaptation controller and reusable parametric skills across heterogeneous text tasks; not a pure medical, vision or robotics application.

primary_link.title: Agentic-TTT: Training test-time policy for test-time training

papers.summary: Test-time training (TTT) adapts an LLM's parameters using signals derived from test inputs, and can make striking improvements in pre-specified settings such as IMO competitions or designated open problems. By turning deployment experience into parameter updates, TTT provides a direct mechanism for model-level self-improvement. Yet TTT is not universally beneficial: each TTT algorithm works in different settings, and applying an ill-suited method could waste test-time compute or even damage model performance. Therefore, such parameter-level self-improvement requires agency: the model must decide when TTT is warranted, which algorithm to invoke, and whether an existing skill can be reused. To fill this gap, we introduce Agentic-TTT, which learns a test-time policy to govern those decisions. Agentic-TTT turns TTT procedures into callable tools, treats accumulated skills as an evolving deployment environment, and trains its policy using the observed utility gains from its decisions. On our benchmark, Agentic-TTT nearly doubles the utility over the backbone model, learns to trade off utility against compute, and generalizes to domains unseen during training. Together, these results point toward autonomous self-improvement: models that can decide how to learn from their own deployment experience.
papers.summary_en: Agentic-TTT learns when to answer directly, build a LoRA skill, or reuse one. Qwen2.5-7B utility rises from 0.256 to 0.510 on 176 queries, but roughly 65% of the curated benchmark favors adaptation. Read the selection protocol before the headline: document QA omits source text at answer time, compute plots measure adaptation cost, and RL starts from gold-action histories. Three training runs and transfer tests support feasibility, while some domains regress. All 26 pages and material figures/tables were read.
papers.summary_zh:
模型在部署後更新參數，未必每次都划算。Agentic-TTT 把五種測試時訓練方法包成工具，由獨立策略 LoRA 決定直接回答、累積資料、建立技能或載入既有技能；基底模型保持凍結，每個技能以獨立 LoRA 保存。策略先模仿經實測篩選的提示引導軌跡，再用逐題效用、運算成本與無效動作懲罰做強化學習。

在八領域、一百七十六題的固定測試流中，Qwen2.5-7B 的平均二元得分由 0.256 升至 0.510。這個近倍增長有重要前提：資料刻意富集適應有效的案例，整體約六成五；完整 MATH-500 依該參考方法達高收益的比例僅百分之七。文件問答還刻意不把原文放進最終回答上下文，因此不等於擊敗一般長文檢索或上下文基準。

先讀附錄的選題與資料流，再看主要表格及運算取捨。三次訓練、跨領域與跨模型測試支持方法可行，但部分模型的個別領域仍退步；成本圖主要量適應運算，不能直接當端到端省時。RL 訓練狀態由標註動作推進，尚未解決真正自主資料流的跨題延遲信用分配。全文二十六頁與圖表已讀；其價值是把「要不要學」變成可研究的決策問題，並非證明普遍部署都能自動、安全地變強。

links.title: Cadence: Strategic Guidance for Coding Agents

evidence: PDF pp.5–8 Figures 3–5/Algorithm 1: a monitor inspects recent trajectory, guidance history and the unexecuted proposal. Advisory executes then appends guidance; replacement discards the proposal and regenerates. Advisory grows interval by delta capped at Imax; replacement resets to Ibase. Default 5/2/20 is on p.9.

PDF pp.3–4 Figures 1–2: motivating study uses GPT-5-mini/GPT-5.2 and retrospectively partitions tasks by vanilla outcome into 145 solved/155 failed. Even the previously solved group has only 88.28–91.72% success under fixed monitoring, illustrating possible regressions and a post-hoc health proxy rather than online health ground truth.

PDF pp.9–10 Table 1: main backbone is Gemini-2.5-Flash with GPT-5.2 monitor, not the motivating GPT-5-mini. mini-swe resolves 17→42.33% (+76/300), tokens 1.42→1.03M; Moatless 24→39.67% (+47/300), tokens .32→.48M. Gains are absolute percentage points, not relative percentages.

PDF p.11 Figure 6 and text: paired two-sided exact McNemar tests with Holm correction reject the main baseline comparisons except LivePlan on Moatless, adjusted p=.1175. The figure uses fixed k=5 only and reports 20 mini-swe/17 Moatless uniquely resolved cases among those selected comparators.

PDF p.12 Table 2: GPT-5-mini improves 48.33→53.00% but tokens increase .35→.46M and leverage falls 1.38→1.15 (reported -16.6%). Qwen agent improvement is 37.67→52.67%; alternative Claude and DeepSeek monitors also help Gemini, with different accuracy/token trade-offs.

PDF pp.13–14 Tables 3–4: full dynamic/two-tier reaches 42.33% at 1.028M tokens; fixed k=3/two-tier reaches 45.67% at 1.182M (15% more), accuracy difference p=.24. Fixed k=5/two-tier reaches 42% at 1.203M; advisory-only/replacement-only reach 35/38%. The original tier recommendation still drives scheduling in the one-tier ablations.

PDF pp.14–17 Figures 7–8/Table 5: 246 solved agent-task runs were annotated, with 112 judged critical interventions (kappa .94); 90 also failed under vanilla. Of 354 failures, step-budget exhaustion is excluded, leaving 284: monitor timing23/misdiagnosis76/bad-guidance65, agent noncompliance8/incomplete realization112. Percentages apply to this restricted denominator.

PDF pp.8–10,17–19: synchronous periodic baseline is an adaptation of asynchronous Wink, Moatless is restricted to linear exploration, and limits are 150/50 steps. Temperature zero is used when supported; GPT-5.2 uses default medium effort. No repeated-run variance, measured dollar cost or wall-clock latency is supplied.

PDF pp.16–17: timing failures occur on short Moatless traces with bundled tools, sometimes before the first check. Threats acknowledge Python-only benchmark and possible contamination; reviewer inference: shared backbone does not guarantee equal contamination benefit across distinct prompting/monitoring policies.

PDF p.19 Data Availability and full pp.1–21: code and per-setup results are linked, but their bytes were not acquired. No in-file appendix or separate required supplement is referenced; full prompt, pseudocode, all eight figures and five tables were read.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-motivated, directly useful monitor design with stronger evaluation discipline than a simple aggregate benchmark report. The primary finding is a quality/token trade-off for the tested model-scaffold pairs, not universal monitoring dominance. Gains are percentage points, and the motivating GPT-5-mini split of 145 solved tasks must not be confused with the main Gemini baseline of 51/300. The same-tier fixed-k=3 variant has a higher accuracy point estimate, while Moatless-versus-LivePlan significance is not established. Total token counts include agent and monitor but do not equate models' input/output/cache/reasoning token prices or measure synchronous latency. Stronger-agent token leverage can deteriorate. Manual critical-intervention labels and separate vanilla failures are suggestive, not counterfactual proof that an individual guidance message was necessary. Failure attribution excludes 70 step-budget failures and therefore describes only 284 of 354 unsuccessful agent-task runs. Short traces can finish before any inspection, and correct test results do not prove semantic patch correctness. Same-backbone contamination is not guaranteed to affect different prompting/inspection policies equally. Full-paper access permits bounded content review without a material-source hold; repository availability and experiments remain unverified externally.

primary_link.title: Cadence: Strategic Guidance for Coding Agents

papers.summary: Runtime monitors are increasingly used to improve the reliability of LLM-based coding agents by inspecting execution trajectories and delivering corrective guidance upon detecting misbehavior. However, their effectiveness remains limited by static guidance triggering schemes. Existing monitors rely either on fixed inspection intervals, missing timely guidance during severe misbehaviors while incurring unnecessary overhead during healthy execution, or on rigid heuristic rules, failing to detect complex reasoning errors. To address these limitations, we propose Cadence, a dynamic monitoring framework that adaptively schedules inspections and delivers guidance according to the agent's real-time execution health. Cadence consists of two core modules: a two-tier intervention module and an inspection scheduler. The intervention module delivers advisory-level guidance for normal executions and minor lapses, while providing replacement-level guidance for severe misbehaviors. Driven by the intervention level, the scheduler adjusts the inspection frequency by tightening supervision after replacement-level guidance and relaxing it after advisory-level guidance. Evaluated on 300 SWE-bench Lite tasks across two distinct agents, mini-swe-agent and Moatless, Cadence achieves the highest resolve rate among all evaluated monitors. Specifically, Cadence outperforms vanilla agents by 25.33\% (+76 resolved tasks) on mini-swe-agent and 15.67\% (+47 resolved tasks) on Moatless, while maintaining competitive token efficiency compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_en: Cadence couples advisory or pre-execution replacement guidance with an adaptive inspection interval. On SWE-bench Lite, the main mini-swe-agent run improves from 17% to 42.33%, with fewer total tokens. Moatless improves from 24% to 39.67% but uses more tokens than vanilla; its advantage over LivePlan is not statistically significant after correction. A fixed three-step two-tier variant has higher accuracy at greater cost. One benchmark, unreplicated model runs and absent dollar/latency accounting limit generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
程式代理需要何時被提醒、何時被攔下？Cadence 讓監督模型檢查最近軌跡與尚未執行的動作，依情況給兩種指導：輕微問題先讓動作執行，再追加建議；嚴重偏離則丟棄提案，要求重新產生。檢查排程跟著調整：收到一般建議後逐步拉長間隔，遇到替換動作便恢復密集檢查。預設從五步開始，每次增加兩步，上限二十步。

在三百題 SWE-bench Lite 中，以 Gemini 2.5 Flash 工作、GPT-5.2 監督，mini-swe-agent 的解題率由百分之十七升至四十二點三三，Moatless 由二十四升至三十九點六七；這是增加二十五點三三與十五點六七個百分點。前者每題總 token 也減少，後者卻由零點三二百萬增至零點四八百萬。換成較強的 GPT-5-mini 工作時，解題率增加，但每 token 效率反而下降。

價值在於把介入強度與檢查時機一起設計，且以配對檢定、消融及失敗分析呈現證據。它仍非普遍最省或最準：固定三步加雙層介入的消融有更高解題率但耗用更多 token；Moatless 相對 LivePlan 的差異未達校正後顯著。短任務可能在首次檢查前結束，監督者也可能誤判。全文二十一頁已讀；尚缺跨基準、重複抽樣、實際金額及端到端延遲驗證，測試通過亦不保證修補在所有情境正確。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A useful serving-system contribution that turns fine-grained model routing into a more practical execution pattern. The paper's strongest evidence is the consistent measured improvement against identified implementations, reinforced by component ablations and a transparent model. The headline range must remain attached to its baselines and workload: official CITER/R2R engines lack continuous batching, while the standard baseline re-admits each returned token and spends most of the measured SLM step in prefix/cache bookkeeping. CUDA-graph engineering supplies much of the improvement; concurrency-one gains do not establish a benefit from asynchronous or delayed scheduling. The threshold is optimal only within a finite, fixed-N, stationary independent-routing, fixed-latency model with the stated irreducibility condition; Figure 10 validates maximizers for R2R at N=2,3,4, not arbitrary routing or production load. Aggregate throughput in Section 5.1 and per-request token/time in Section 5.4 should not be silently equated. Original-setting Co-LLM and R-Stitch can have lower aggregate throughput than LLM-only despite shorter completion latency, so universal dominance is unsupported. Quality evidence is mainly one AMC23 frontier, not token-for-token parity across every backend. No latency-tail, changing-load or numerical equivalence guarantee is established. All in-file sources are complete; external release and reproduction are unverified.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 這份服務系統工作讓 token 級模型路由更接近實用，最有力的是針對明確實作的穩定效能改善、模組消融與可檢查的數學模型。最大加速區間必須連同基線解讀：原始 CITER／R2R 引擎缺連續組批，標準基線每次返回 token 都重新進站，所測小模型步驟大多花在前綴與快取管理。CUDA graph 已貢獻大量增益，單請求結果不能拿來證明非同步或延後組批有效。門檻只在固定並行量、平穩獨立路由、固定延遲與所述不可約條件的有限模型內最佳；圖十僅驗證 R2R 的二、三、四並行量，不代表任意路由或生產負載。第五節的總體吞吐與後段每請求 token／時間定義也不能混用。原始設定的 Co-LLM、R-Stitch 雖縮短完成延遲，總吞吐仍可低於單獨大模型，因此不能宣稱普遍支配。品質證據主要是一個 AMC23 前緣，沒有各後端逐 token 等價檢查，也沒有尾端延遲或變動負載保證。原件與附錄已完整讀取，外部釋出及重現尚未驗證。

primary_link.title: TokenRouter: Efficient Serving System for Token-Level LLM Routing

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) routing distributes inference work across different models, advancing the cost-quality Pareto frontier of LLM serving. While coarse-grained routing at the session or query level has been widely adopted in production systems, recent algorithmic work shows that fine-grained token-level routing can yield substantial efficiency and quality gains. However, efficiently serving token-level routed inference poses significant challenges to existing systems. Built on single-LLM assumptions, current systems suffer from severe step desynchronization and frequent batch admission delays under token-level routing, and they also impose high implementation complexity on developers. To address these challenges, we design TokenRouter, an efficient and developer-friendly serving system for token-level routed LLM inference. TokenRouter follows the principle of request-centric programming, model-centric execution: developers describe routing logic from the perspective of a single request, while the runtime launches a subserver for each LLM and dispatches requests asynchronously. Each subserver employs a delayed-batching scheduler, whose optimal hyperparameters are derived from a mathematical throughput model of the system. Across diverse routing algorithms, workloads, and model pairs, TokenRouter achieves 2.01-64.15x higher decoding throughput than existing systems, substantially advancing the serving efficiency of token-level LLM routing. Our code is available at https://github.com/thu-nics/TokenRouter.
papers.summary_en: TokenRouter separates routing policy from asynchronous per-model serving, preserves request state across handoffs and tunes delayed batching with a Markov model. Reported gains of 2.01–64.15× are against specific token-routing baselines, some with costly per-token re-admission. R2R's concurrency-eight ablation yields a clearer 2.76× overall gain, with substantial CUDA-graph contribution. Fixed-load assumptions, limited threshold validation, missing tail latency and incomplete output-equivalence tests limit deployment claims.
papers.summary_zh:
讓小模型處理容易的 token、遇到困難再換大模型，演算法上很省，服務系統卻可能因反覆切換而變慢。TokenRouter 把路由政策與執行分開：開發者只定義何時轉送、傳哪些狀態及如何接收；每個模型由獨立子伺服器非同步運作，請求轉出時保留快取狀態，回來便直接續跑。延後組批再讓同模型請求湊成較大的批次，以減少反覆等待；門檻由馬可夫模型估計。

作者測試五種路由方法與三類工作負載，報告相對所列較強基線有二點零一至六十四點一五倍吞吐。但最大倍數不能直接套在一般單模型服務：部分原始實作沒有連續組批，標準基線又逐 token 重新進站。較容易解讀的是 R2R 消融：同時八個請求下，吞吐由每秒約一百三十五增至三百七十二，其中 CUDA graph 本身已帶來不少增益。

這是把細粒度模型協作落實為可用服務的系統工作，並非新路由準確率演算法。最佳門檻依賴固定並行量、近似固定步延遲及平穩、跨請求獨立的路由假設；實驗只在 R2R 的二至四並行情境核對門檻。單請求時，非同步與延後組批沒有額外收益，改善主要來自工程優化。全文二十一頁與附錄已讀；缺少突發流量、尾端延遲、統計區間及完整生成等價驗證，因此不能把平均吞吐優勢當成所有部署的服務保證。

links.title: QUILT: Rethinking Sparse-Attention Prefill through Shared Query Execution

evidence: PDF pp.1–2/Figures 1–2: neighboring GLM-5.3 queries show strong Top-K overlap on Qasper and GovReport. Motivation profiles also name DeepSeek-4.1, whereas the main evaluated models in Section 4 and result tables are GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-3.2. These distinct model scopes must not be conflated.

PDF pp.6–7/Figures 5–6 and Equations 1–7: SCSD concatenates unique Top-K index sets with source labels, sorts, and uses adjacent equality plus masks to extract intersection and differences. The displayed derivation is two-way; the paper says it generalizes but gives no full multi-way implementation or executable artifact here.

PDF pp.7–8/Figure 7/Table 1: an eight-query default cascade extracts all-group sharing then smaller-subgroup sharing and private residuals. The four-query toy example reduces processed KV entries from sixteen to eight, versus ten at either fixed group size two or four; it is an explanatory example, not the measured speedup.

PDF p.8/Section 3.4/Figure 8: shared tails below 50% tile occupancy are pushed down exactly, while the last private tail loses its lowest-indexer-score entries. This residual clipping is the explicitly approximate step, distinct from exact cross-query data reuse.

PDF pp.8–9/Section 4.1: testbed is reported as sixteen Ascend 910C NPUs with 64 GB HBM each, CANN 9.1.0 and XYServe. Both QUILT and OPS-Transformer are integrated in the same engine. The paper does not establish GPU implementation results or specify complete timing/repeat, TP/SP degree and runtime-pinning details.

PDF p.9/Figure 9/Table 3: GLM-5.3 TP kernel reductions are 53.2%, 55.1%, 54.5%, 52.4% over four workloads; 55.1% is a workload/configuration maximum, not the average over every experiment. Mean processed-KV reductions are reported as 54.7% for GLM and 30.4% for DeepSeek; processed accesses are not total model-memory capacity.

PDF p.10/Section 4.2.4/Figure 11: GLM TP TTFT reductions are 34.6%, 36.5%, 36.8%, 34.5%, mean 35.6%; GLM SP mean is 10.4%. DeepSeek TP mean is 23.0%, while prose reports SP mean 3.4%. TTFT is first-token latency, not decode throughput or complete response latency.

PDF pp.9–10/Figures 9 and 11: the legend uses hatched bars for GLM-5.3 and dotted bars for DeepSeek-3.2. Figure 9 uses a 0–50% SP axis; its dotted QA/GO/MU/NA bars visually agree with the prose values 25.9/17.5/9.9/15.0%. Figure 11 uses a separate 0–15% SP axis: dotted DeepSeek Qasper is approximately 3.4%, while the taller hatched GLM bar is 7.0%. DeepSeek SP TTFT values are stated as 3.4/3.6/2.4/4.3%, mean 3.4%. The original review confused the plotted series/scales; no plot/prose inconsistency is established. Decimal values here come from prose, not new pixel-derived measurements or timing replication.

PDF p.10/Figure 10: controlled overlap lengths from zero to 2048 demonstrate more reuse gives lower kernel latency, but very low sharing incurs overhead, especially with sequence-parallel pipeline warmup. This qualifies near-zero-overhead and universal-speedup interpretations.

PDF pp.10–11/Figures 12–13/Table 4: naive Torch intersection is over twenty times baseline latency, whereas vectorization and pipelining restore a benefit. These very large reductions are relative to an inefficient naive implementation; they are not the headline improvement over optimized OPS-Transformer. Cascaded sharing outperforms fixed groups in the reported setup.

PDF pp.11–12/Figures 14–15: removing final residuals reduces kernel latency versus the exact, unclipped variant by 23.71%/22.68% for GLM TP/SP and 24.44%/14.13% for DeepSeek. GLM importance-aware clipping has rounded mean cosine 1.0000 but minima 0.406 per head and 0.719 per hidden vector, so average similarity does not imply uniformly tiny perturbation.

PDF p.9/Table 2: 21 task metrics show mean absolute differences reported as 0.42 points for GLM and 0.75 for DeepSeek. Individual DeepSeek changes include hotpotqa −1.45, triviaqa −1.35 and musique +2.71. No confidence intervals or per-example equivalence guarantee is provided.

PDF pp.12–14/Related Work, Conclusion and references: work concerns concurrent prefill query reuse, distinct from decoding KV-cache management. Baseline and serving references are given, but a verified QUILT source release, checkpoint hashes and reproduction commands were not inspected or executed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: QUILT identifies a plausible and measured source of sparse-prefill inefficiency and supplies an integrated kernel design with useful ablations. The same-engine comparison and TTFT measurements go beyond a synthetic kernel speedup alone, and the plotted results agree with the prose when the model legend and separate panel scales are read correctly. Nevertheless, the best percentages are configuration maxima, the full method includes approximate residual clipping, and mean fidelity coexists with much lower worst-case cosine similarity. Single-platform evaluation and missing timing/reproduction details warrant a bounded systems assessment rather than a universal acceleration or losslessness claim.

Nevertheless, the best percentages are configuration maxima, the full method includes approximate residual clipping, and mean fidelity coexists with much lower worst-case cosine similarity. llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: QUILT 找出合理且經量測的稀疏預填充浪費來源，並以完整核心設計與多項消融呈現改進。共同服務引擎及首 token 延遲測試，比僅有合成核心加速更有實用性；正確辨識模型圖例及各面板尺度後，圖中結果與正文一致。但最佳百分比只是特定設定的上限，完整方法包含近似私有 KV 裁切，平均高相似度仍伴隨較低的最差 cosine。單一硬體平台及量測與重現細節不足，仍要求以有界的系統成果評估，不能視為通用加速或無損保證。

primary_link.title: QUILT: Rethinking Sparse-Attention Prefill through Shared Query Execution

papers.summary: Sparse attention reduces the cost of long-context attention, but existing kernels typically process queries independently, repeatedly loading and dequantizing KV entries shared across queries. We observe substantial overlap in the KV entries selected by neighboring queries, creating opportunities for cross-query reuse. We present QUILT, a workload-aware sparse-attention execution mechanism that jointly processes neighboring queries and reuses shared KV entries to reduce redundant memory traffic and computation. QUILT introduces Shift-and-Compare Set Decomposition (SCSD), which transforms irregular set operations into regular data-parallel primitives suitable for modern accelerators, and pipelines SCSD with attention computation to hide its overhead. Cascaded sharing captures reuse hierarchically at multiple granularities. A tile-aware execution strategy balances sharing granularity with hardware tile utilization and selectively removes low-importance query-specific tails to eliminate underutilized tiles. We evaluate QUILT on LongBench using GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-3.2 under both tensor and sequence parallelism. Compared with the state-of-the-art sparse-attention kernel, QUILT reduces average kernel latency by up to 55.1% and processed KV data by up to 55.9%, while reducing time-to-first-token (TTFT) latency by up to 36.8% with negligible accuracy degradation.
papers.summary_en: QUILT groups neighboring sparse-attention queries to reuse KV loads and dequantization, pipelines set decomposition, and cascades sharing across group sizes. On Ascend 910C, reported reductions reach 55.1% for kernel latency and 36.8% for TTFT. Read the clipping ablation: full results include approximate KV removal, not only exact reordering. Average fidelity masks a minimum head cosine of 0.406. Gains depend on model and parallelism; GPU portability and repeat-run uncertainty remain untested. All 14 pages were read.
papers.summary_zh:
稀疏注意力雖然只讀取部分 KV，相鄰查詢往往仍反覆載入、解量化同一批資料。QUILT 不改變主要索引選取流程，而把查詢分組：先排序並位移比較索引，找出共同與私有集合，再從較大群組逐層分解到小群組，讓共享 KV 只搬運與處理一次。集合分解穿插在矩陣運算留下的向量執行空檔，並按硬體區塊利用率調整分工。

在十六顆 Ascend 910C、同一 XYServe 環境中，文中報告 GLM-5.3 與 DeepSeek-3.2 的稀疏預填充核心延遲最多下降 55.1%，首 token 延遲最多下降 36.8%。兩者是不同層級的指標，效益也依模型與平行方式變動；DeepSeek 在序列平行的平均首 token 改善僅 3.4%。圖中的斜線柱代表 GLM、點狀柱代表 DeepSeek，兩個面板的縱軸尺度也不同。

閱讀時要分開精確共享與近似裁切：共享尾端往下層移動仍保留語意，但最後會刪除低排序的私有 KV，因此完整方案不是完全等價的執行重排。二十一項 LongBench 評分大致接近，不代表每題無損；平均輸出相似度近一，最差單頭卻只有 0.406。全文十四頁、十五圖與四表已讀。缺少跨 GPU 實測、重複量測區間及完整重現參數，故適合作為長上下文核心設計參考，不宜直接換算成所有推論服務都能省下相同比例的時間。

links.title: Skill-V: Verifiable Self-Evolving Skill Library for Interactive Agents

evidence: PDF pp.4–6/Sections 3.1–3.4 and Figure 2: skills combine protected semantic intent, procedure, optional executable rubric and versions. Failure motivates addition; rubric/outcome disagreement motivates bidirectional boundary revisions. Whole-trajectory outcomes are explicitly not causal attribution to individual skills.

PDF p.7/Table 1: selected 7B Skill-V checkpoint gives ALFWorld 95.3%, WebShop score 92.5 and success 85.9%. Skill1 gives 97.5%, 89.7 and 82.9%, respectively. Skill-V does not have the best overall ALFWorld success; its gain over RetroAgent there is only 0.4 points without uncertainty intervals.

PDF p.8/Table 2: fixing the final policy and varying available knowledge yields no skills 78.59%, initial library 88.99%, evolved library 95.30%, a 6.31-point gain over the initial library. This supports external-library contribution but does not independently isolate contract revision from acquisition/filtering.

PDF pp.8–9/Tables 3–6: Static Library 73.4%, Acquisition Only 68.8%, Failure-only 67.2%, full 95.3%; no Evidence Gate 75.0%; semantic retrieval 71.9%, deterministic checks without LLM judge 89.1%; adding process reward 93.8%. These are mechanism comparisons with no reported multi-seed intervals or equal-total-API-cost accounting.

PDF p.9/Table 4: ungated run commits 46 revisions, 37 are replay non-regressive and 27 pass the complete retrospective gate; full method commits ten, all passing. Passing the rule used for acceptance is expected by construction and cannot independently certify unseen behavior.

PDF pp.13–17/Algorithm 1 and Tables 7–9: training experiences alone evolve the library; copied validation libraries stay read-only. Rubric matching uses task/action/observation evidence, excluding policy thoughts; only predefined literal, regex and bounded event operators are described, not execution of model-generated code.

PDF pp.15–16/B.3–B.4: new semantic skills with PENDING_COMPILATION are immediately retrievable and can condition the policy, while remaining ineligible to produce rubric judgments. Thus the deterministic rubric gate is not a guarantee that every piece of policy guidance has been executably verified.

PDF p.17/B.6: Disc and FNR must not increase and BAcc must not decrease; hard-criterion edits require one strict improvement. FNR≤0.05 and Disc≤0.15 are updater targets, not hard acceptance requirements. Old and new rubrics use the same trajectory pool but effective supports may diverge after applicability changes.

PDF pp.15 and 17/Table 8/B.6: two illustrated edits use ten and twelve replay cases. The relaxed-loop revision is accepted with FNR 0.667 and Disc 0.333. Missing positive or negative classes receive optimistic missing-rate conventions; nonempty support alone does not establish broad coverage or held-out reliability.

PDF pp.17–19/B.7/C: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B retrieval, DeepSeek-V4-Flash judge/updater, 7B policy, GRPO eight rollouts and eight GPUs. Judge confidence≥0.8 filters candidates; failures fall back to original embedding Top-K after two attempts. Judge labels on 29.6% of retrieved candidates are not independently validated ground truth.

PDF pp.18–20/Tables 10–12: results use selected step-150 checkpoints; ALFWorld validation samples at temperature 0.4, WebShop is greedy. Stored entries are 55→205 and 66→153, with ten and fourteen accepted revisions. ALFWorld 205/5000 is 4.1%, not the main-text claim of less than 4%; stored units are explicitly not directly comparable.

PDF pp.12–13/Appendix A: scope is discrete text criteria; no deletion mechanism removes fundamentally flawed skills, and historical evidence can become stale when environment rules change. Safety constraints are proposed future extensions. No separate long-term forgetting or adversarial safety study establishes the stronger conclusion rhetoric.

PDF pp.19–20/C.4/E: external-model roles, token limits, retry/circuit-breaker behavior and three effective prompt templates are reported. The cited DeepSeek bibliography entry on p.10 names V3.2 while the implementation specifies V4-Flash; a pinned actual runtime and external release were not independently verified.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Skill-V provides a concrete, inspectable approach to maintaining procedural memory instead of only growing it. The fixed-policy 6.31-point gain over the initial library and mechanism ablations support useful external knowledge in this setup. Claims of universal non-regression, safe evolution or catastrophic-forgetting prevention are stronger than the evidence: replay metrics are historical, support can change, pending semantic skills are immediately usable, and the gate does not establish individual-skill causal effects. Two text domains, no reported repeated-run uncertainty, unmatched external-model cost and unverified release artifacts keep the assessment provisional and bounded.

primary_link.title: Skill-V: Verifiable Self-Evolving Skill Library for Interactive Agents

papers.summary: Interactive agents can turn experience into reusable skills, yet existing self-evolving skill libraries primarily improve by accumulating new knowledge. Failures may lead to new skills, while previously stored skills are less often revisited as new evidence arrives. However, growth alone does not ensure reliability, as a retrieved skill may be inapplicable under the current task conditions, and an existing skill may encode a mis-specified operational boundary. Reliable skill evolution therefore requires not only adding knowledge, but also testing and revising what is already stored. We introduce Skill-V, a verifiable self-evolving skill library. To make stored knowledge testable, we propose representing skills as versioned, falsifiable contracts that link semantic intent to observable behavioral criteria. We use environment outcomes to drive library evolution. Specifically, task failures motivate skill addition, while disagreements between contract evaluations and task outcomes guide revisions to existing skill boundaries. To validate these revisions, we require them to preserve protected semantic constraints and satisfy non-regression criteria for rubric-outcome metrics on historical replay evidence. Finally, we employ an applicability-aware filter to exclude candidates judged confidently inapplicable to the current task. Across ALFWorld and WebShop, Skill-V achieves success rates of 95.3% and 85.9%, respectively, while maintaining a more compact skill library than growth-oriented baselines. Applicability-aware filtering reduces incorrect skill invocations, and outcome-grounded revisions correct mis-specified skill boundaries without degrading performance on previously observed evidence. These results show that reliable skill evolution requires more than accumulating experience: the library must learn which knowledge to retain, when to revise it, and when it should be applied.
papers.summary_en: Skill-V revises versioned skill contracts when executable rubrics disagree with task outcomes, then gates edits on historical replay. A 7B agent reaches 95.3% on ALFWorld and 85.9% on WebShop; ALFWorld remains below Skill1. A fixed-policy ablation supports external-library value. Read the gate carefully: applicability edits can change effective support, pending skills still guide actions, and replay consistency does not guarantee future safety. Multi-seed uncertainty and full cost comparisons are absent. All 20 pages were read.
papers.summary_zh:
代理遇到失敗就新增技能，可能越存越多，卻仍不知道舊方法何時不適用。Skill-V 把自然語言技能拆成受保護的語意、操作程序與可執行評準；環境結果和評準不一致時，由外部模型提議修訂，再用歷史軌跡重播，比較分歧率、成功案例誤拒率與平衡準確率。只有保留語意、具有可執行證據且指標不退步的版本才取代舊契約；檢索後另以適用性判斷排除明確不合的技能。

七十億參數代理在 ALFWorld 的成功率為 95.3%，WebShop 為 85.9%。前者低於 Skill1 的 97.5%，後者高三個百分點；不宜概括成兩項皆最佳。固定最終策略後，演進技能庫比初始庫多 6.31 個百分點，較能說明外部知識的作用。ALFWorld 實際保存二百零五項、接受十次修訂，但與其他方法的技能單位未必可直接相比。

最值得讀的是驗證閘門和附錄的邊界條件：不退步只針對已觀察的重播指標，修改適用性仍可能改變有效樣本，不能保證未來任務或防止災難性遺忘。新技能尚未編成可執行評準時也能影響策略；外部模型判斷不等於形式證明。全文二十頁已讀，未見多種子區間、完整成本對照或非定常環境測試。此作適合借鑑可追溯的技能維護流程，尚不能作為通用安全保證。

evidence: PDF pp.3–5 Eqs.1–6: tasks combine instruction, database, harness and hidden oracle; the agent exposes table/schema/execute/submit tools, with observation tokens masked during full-trajectory SFT. The SFT corpus has 2,512 episodes from 79 databases; RL reports 2,700 prompts and 100 validation instances.

PDF pp.6–7 Tables 1–2: Qwen3-8B progresses 15.5→30.4→45.2% and 14B 22.2→37.8→54.8%; direct RL for 8B reaches 20.0%. OOD final scores are BI-mini 9.0/11.3% and LSB 24.8/28.5%. These are author-reported accuracies without shown confidence intervals.

PDF p.7 Table 3: base model 2.2% non-harness versus 15.5% DSH-SQL; non-harness SFT evaluated within DSH-SQL reaches 9.6%, while harness-native SFT reaches 30.4%. It is this same-harness contrast, not larger-model native-protocol comparisons alone, that most directly supports training-interface alignment.

PDF p.7 Figure 3: turn-split/full-trajectory scores are 19.3/23.0%, 3.0/4.0% and 11.5/14.8%. Both formulations condition on preceding history. Reviewer inference: equivalent unnormalized token-loss sums can differ because of weighting, batching, truncation or optimization; the graph alone does not isolate loss of interaction structure. The 23.0% full-trajectory result also differs from the main 30.4% checkpoint without a fully specified figure configuration.

PDF p.8 Figure 4/Table 4: S2 accuracy rises from 27.4 to 37.0 to 45.2% for 8K/16K/32K; DAPO/GSPO/GRPO reach 45.2/43.7/40.7% S2, while GSPO is slightly higher than DAPO on LSB, 25.2 versus 24.8%. No universal DAPO dominance is claimed here.

PDF pp.13–17 Tables 5–10: inherited DSH loop versus SQL-specific additions are distinguished; audit counts are 138 session logs for 135 tasks, not 138 unique tasks. Behavioral analysis uses four rollouts per task/540 trajectories per checkpoint; invalid-call incidence falls 67.41→17.41→0.56%. Valid-submit incidence is a protocol measure, not execution accuracy.

PDF pp.17–18 Appendix D: 3,230 of 3,989 failed intermediate executions are leading-comment guard rejections (reviewer calculation about 81%). Removing those failed interaction turns gives 28.2 versus 30.4% SFT accuracy, a 2.2-point single reported difference rather than proof of general recovery robustness.

PDF pp.18–20 Appendix E/Tables 12–14: all 30 S2 SQLite files are byte-identical between training and evaluation; no task-ID/question/result fingerprint matches and no cosine ≥0.75 were reported. The semantic audit covers 1,797 same-database synthesis examples, not an independent proof against every source of contamination; shared schemas/data remain part of the setting.

PDF pp.6,20–22 Appendix F/Table 15 versus Appendix G: main baselines use native protocols and degrade under DSH-SQL, e.g. OmniSQL-32B 14.8→1.5% S2; Appendix G nevertheless says all models were uniformly evaluated in DSH-SQL. PDF p.14 says BIRD exposes nine operations, unlike blanket four-tool statements.

PDF p.3 Eq.2 versus p.17 Eq.13: conceptual reward multiplies result correctness by protocol compliance, while effective reward lists execution-result/alias checks without specifying the same duplicate-call predicates. Query tool deadline is 60 seconds; verifier deadline is separately 30 seconds. Failed harness processes are removed groupwise during training, while evaluation failures count against the denominator.

PDF pp.10,16–17,22–24: concrete SFT/DAPO settings, data-record structure, difficulty formula, two SQL examples and verifier checklist are included. The abstract says code is released; the reproducibility statement promises a future final snapshot. Actual external availability, exact benchmark snapshots, raw audit data and full launch manifests were not inspected.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly relevant evidence that a compact model benefits from learning the actual SQL interaction interface, with substantial gains in the reported configuration. This is a systems/training integration rather than a fundamentally new RL algorithm. The shared-database setting is explicitly disclosed: exact-question, lexical, embedding and result audits find no overlaps but cannot prove absence of all semantic/template leakage or establish unseen-schema transfer. Appendix D shows 3,230 of 3,989 intermediate failures were caused by a comment-prefix guard, so error-recovery improvements partly measure adaptation to the harness. Native-protocol baselines are defensible but not compute-matched; Appendix G's claim of uniform DSH-SQL evaluation contradicts the main protocol and Appendix F. Appendix A also changes BIRD to nine tools, contrary to the blanket four-tool wording. Equation 2 imposes protocol predicates while Appendix C's effective reward is result-based, leaving their exact conjunction underspecified. Full-trajectory versus turn-split training both condition on the history; without matched sampling, token weighting and truncation, the reported gap does not uniquely establish that structural history is lost by splitting. The PDF is complete and permits an appropriately limited assessment; no external code execution, release validation or replication is claimed.

primary_link.title: HarnessSQL: Harness-Native Training for SQL Agents in Realistic Database Environments

papers.summary: Text-to-SQL models are commonly trained to map questions directly to static queries, whereas real-world database agents operate through stateful, multi-turn interaction with live databases -- inspecting schemas, executing probe queries, diagnosing errors, and revising hypotheses. This creates a critical train-deploy mismatch, as the execution harness that mediates this interaction is introduced only at inference time. To bridge this gap, we propose HarnessSQL, a harness-native post-training framework that preserves the full interaction structure throughout both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. HarnessSQL builds isolated, executable database environments paired with hidden execution oracles, rolls out teachers directly inside the target SQL harness, and retains only verified trajectories for full-sequence SFT, followed by execution-reward RL. Across Spider 2.0-SQLite, HarnessSQL dramatically boosts the execution accuracy of compact models, raising Qwen3-8B from 15.5% to 45.2% and Qwen3-14B from 22.2% to 54.8%, while transferring effectively to out-of-distribution interactive benchmarks such as BIRD-Interact and LiveSQLBench. Our findings demonstrate that training database agents directly within their execution harness is essential for mastering complex, long-horizon database workflows.
papers.summary_en: HarnessSQL trains compact SQL agents inside their deployment harness using verified interaction traces, then execution-reward RL. Reported Spider 2.0-SQLite accuracy rises from 15.5% to 45.2% for 8B and 22.2% to 54.8% for 14B. The test shares byte-identical databases with synthesis; overlap audits reduce concerns but do not prove contamination impossible. Most intermediate failures are comment-guard rejections. OOD gains, protocol inconsistencies and missing uncertainty support a bounded, harness-specific conclusion.
papers.summary_zh:
會寫 SQL，未必會使用資料庫工具。HarnessSQL 把訓練目標從一次輸出查詢，改為在實際執行框架中學會查表、看結構、試跑、讀錯誤及提交。作者先以可執行查詢生成任務與隱藏答案，再讓教師模型透過四個限定工具蒐集成功軌跡；學生接受整段軌跡的監督訓練，只對代理產生的內容計算損失，接著用執行結果獎勵做強化學習。

在一百三十五題 Spider 2.0-SQLite 上，八十億參數模型由百分之十五點五升至四十五點二，一百四十億參數模型由二十二點二升至五十四點八。固定推論框架後，原生軌跡訓練也優於靜態訓練，顯示學會工具協定有實際價值。不過這是共享資料庫的新問題測試：三十個 SQLite 檔案與訓練端完全相同。作者的文字、語意及結果比對未找到重複任務，不能因此宣稱完全排除所有污染。

附錄尤其值得讀：近八成中途執行失敗來自查詢開頭註解遭保護器拒絕，反映部分改善是適應特定工具。外部分布測試仍有增益，但絕對成功率較低；主要比較使用各基線原生協定，並非一致的互動預算。全文二十四頁已讀，保留附錄協定描述矛盾、缺信賴區間及版本細節等限制；結果支持這組 SQL 工具與訓練配方，尚非所有代理皆必須如此訓練的證明。

evidence: PDF pp.3–5, Eqs.1–5/Figures 2–4: executable simulator state is separate from generated appearance; geometry conditioning uses depth or normals, with text and a reference frame. Rendering errors can influence chosen actions even though they do not directly rewrite the simulator state.

PDF p.9 Tables 1–2: one H100/BF16/480×832 test reports 3.99% versus bitwise-zero replay error, 2.95 versus 2.79 seconds forward time and 50.83 versus 50.92 GiB. Forward medians use three warmed runs and exclude backward/optimizer; serving averages blocks 17–48 over two rollouts, with 438.8 ms per 16 frames and 36.5 fps.

PDF p.10 Figure 8: five paired selected 30-second trajectories show less repetitive texture under Adversarial Forcing. No reported aggregate perceptual metric or human preference study establishes general visual superiority.

PDF pp.11,13–14 Section 5/Table 3: one hider prepares before the seeker; each round contains five games and uses separate role playbooks. Shelter/ramp milestones are rounds 4/10, compared narratively with roughly 25/100 million tabula-rasa RL episodes. The paper explicitly says these are fundamentally different paradigms, not a direct sample-efficiency ratio.

PDF p.15 Table 4: each additional-world row has one episode per round. Companion engagement 13/14/19/19, bridge times 71/68/45/41 seconds, herding scores 60/90.1/87.6/88.3, quarry scores 30/0/30/90.9. These are descriptive trajectories without uncertainty or no-playbook controls.

PDF pp.13,15,26: Section 5.4 says all four worlds use first-person observations, but the quarry task file explicitly specifies an elevated third-person camera and Figure 12 depicts that view. This is a source inconsistency; all-first-person generalization is not adopted.

PDF pp.16,23: geometry leaves color/material/identity and symmetric rotations unspecified; thin geometry and long occlusions can undermine observations. Cache remapping and a permanent sink do not prove unlimited visual memory; cross-world generalization is future work.

llm_evaluation.rationale: A useful systems-and-methods prototype for language agents practicing in programmable visual worlds. The strongest narrow contributions are exact replay under matching numerical execution and a mathematically scoped R1/R2 construction; neither establishes universal rendering fidelity. The agent evidence is exploratory: a sequential one-hider/one-seeker variant, five games per round, web-pretrained agents and code-valued actions differ materially from tabula-rasa RL. The headline four-round comparison cannot be a sample-efficiency ratio. No-playbook, conventional-renderer, multiple-seed and held-out transfer comparisons are absent. Additional-world outcomes are single episodes and not uniformly monotone. Serving throughput excludes the agent's reasoning, simulator and network latency; world time pauses during thinking. primary_link.title: AgentGarten: Code Worlds for Evolving Agents

papers.summary: Interactive virtual worlds allow agents to learn through exploration and interaction. What agents can learn is bounded by the environments they practice in, which must be faithful, with consistent state, rules, and dynamics, and realistic, with observations that follow the real-world visual distributions. Achieving both across diverse worlds remains a bottleneck. We introduce AgentGarten, a framework that couples simulators and game engines with a shared neural renderer to build real-time interactive environments. Its simulation backends maintain persistent world state and execute program-defined interaction rules, while the renderer generates visual observations from structured conditions exported through a common interface. To build the neural renderer, we adapt a pretrained video model to geometry conditions, distill it with our proposed Adversarial Forcing, and optimize inference for real-time interaction. Adversarial Forcing makes history prefilling differentiable through exact replay, so that losses on later predictions update how the renderer encodes prior observations, and adds real-data adversarial supervision to improve its visual quality. In AgentGarten, agents perceive the world through visual observations, interact with it in real time, and improve by distilling each round of experience into playbooks that subsequent agents inherit and refine. Our empirical study demonstrates a substantial gain in learning efficiency, with agents learning from just 4 rounds compared with millions for a conventional reinforcement learning counterpart. As new worlds can be written as code and rendered through the same interface, environments can scale in both number and difficulty alongside their agents, a step toward agents that keep evolving through interactive experience.
papers.summary_en: AgentGarten separates executable world state from neural-rendered observations and passes written playbooks between pretrained agents. Exact replay restores history-encoding gradients; a frozen-backbone construction supplies exact R1/R2 head gradients. The reported 36.5 fps is block throughput, and four rounds are not four episodes or a fair comparison with RL from scratch. Single-run agent examples, missing playbook controls, qualitative visual evaluation and a camera-description inconsistency limit the claims.

作者在單張 H100 上報告每秒三十六點五影格，但每個十六影格區塊仍需約四百三十九毫秒，並非每影格都能立即重新決策。躲貓貓中，第四輪出現築牆、第十輪使用斜坡；每輪包含五局，而且代理已經預訓練，因此不能把它與從零訓練的數千萬局直接換算為效率提升。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A strong match to agent-memory interests with several unusually helpful controls: the equal-position text supplement tests whether simply adding more summary text suffices, and the fixed-summary action experiment isolates the next decision more cleanly than divergent full trajectories. These support a real but bounded residual-channel benefit. The5.2% figure is a sequence-length ratio, not a reduction in end-to-end compute or memory construction. The method retains ordinary archive retrieval, uses actor-specific1.94B/1.502B trainable networks and requires continuous-vector inputs. End-to-end browsing/terminal scores have no repeated-run uncertainty; workflow repetition is more informative. Raw counts of repeated/error outputs and the two trading trajectories cannot establish lower per-action error or superior investment performance. Token-equivalent dollar costs omit encoding, memory execution and tools; JobBench actually costs more. The source openly states many of these limits, which the review preserves. Full source availability does not substitute for released code, settings or independent replication.

primary_link.title: REMORY: Learning Residual Memory for Context Compaction

papers.summary: Long-horizon agents compact their history to continue within a finite context window, but a textual summary alone may not support every subsequent decision. We introduce REMORY, a neural memory network that supplements the summary with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens. Given the history and summary, the network learns to generate tokens that help a frozen LLM approximate the continuation it would produce with the full history. The tokens are conditioned on the summary and appended after it, forming an analogue of a residual connection along the sequence dimension. On SummHay, REMORY improves source attribution at nearly unchanged insight coverage and approaches the full-context joint score using only 5.2% of the input positions. Across long-horizon agent benchmarks, Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3-Flash show consistent gains with residual memory. Both models also exhibit substantially fewer repeated tool outputs and tool errors on BrowseComp and Terminal-Bench 2.1.
papers.summary_en: REMORY adds up to 4096 learned soft tokens to a text summary, training through a frozen actor to match full-history continuations. On 92 SummHay queries, citation F1 rises from 56.98 to61.03 while coverage barely changes; 5.2% refers to input positions, not total compute. Two actors improve on browsing and terminal tasks, each tested once; workflow results include five runs. Aggregate tool counts are confounded by trajectory length; token-priced costs omit memory and tool overhead. Fixed-summary action judgments support a bounded benefit.
papers.summary_zh: 長任務代理把歷史壓成文字摘要後，可能記得主線卻失去下一步需要的細節。REMORY 保留可讀摘要，再用神經記憶網路讀取歷史與摘要，產生最多四千零九十六個連續軟詞元，讓凍結的執行模型接續工作；精確紀錄仍透過一般檢索工具取得。訓練先學重建，再讓「摘要加記憶」的回答分布接近完整歷史，並非保證找回所有被省略的事實。SummHay 的九十二個查詢中，引用 F1 從五十六點九八升至六十一點零三，內容涵蓋率幾乎不變，聯合分數接近全文；輸入位置僅占全文百分之五點二，但這不包含編碼及記憶網路運算。兩個執行模型的瀏覽與終端任務均有提升，另兩個工作流程基準提供五次執行的平均與標準差。重要限制是前兩類任務每設定只跑一次，工具重複與錯誤是總次數，會受軌跡長度影響；所報費用也只是等價詞元生成成本，不能當整體省錢證據。固定摘要後的行動盲評補強了記憶通道的作用，但未執行反事實動作，交易案例亦不能證明投資效果。方法值得關注，重現仍需更完整訓練設定、消融與釋出物。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A highly relevant diagnostic proposal with real multi-agent results, rather than a demonstrated causal law that stronger agents become less humble. The distinction between task success, post-recognition effort and communicating a specific conflict is useful. Tables support selected configurations with high accuracy but poor error escalation and mixed effects from a prompt-only intervention. However the natural task pools differ, harness/backbone effects are inseparable and error-conditioned plots compare different failure subsets. Solve is a syntactic bounded-action proxy, not proof that evidence was checked successfully. Figure 4 tracks answer mentions and does not establish loss of recognized uncertainty. Human-judge agreement is moderate; the PDF also contradicts itself about broad hedges versus substantive escalation, GPT-5 versus GPT-5.2, and alternate-judge strictness. These issues warrant lower rigor/evidence scores, not invented corrections or a claim of fabricated experiments. The complete PDF supports this qualified assessment without a blanket source hold; exact external reproducibility remains unverified.

primary_link.title: Accurate but Not Humble: Evaluating Epistemic Humility in LLM Agents under Knowledge Conflict

papers.summary: When retrieved evidence contradicts an agent's prior beliefs, does it revise its answer, acknowledge uncertainty, or persist with an incorrect conclusion? Existing evaluations of agentic systems focus primarily on task success, offering limited insight into how agents handle such conflicts. We propose to evaluate agents on epistemic humility (EH): the agent's willingness to recognize, act on, and communicate uncertainty during task execution. We operationalize EH through three trajectory-level behavioral dimensions: Identify, Solve, and Escalate (ISE). Through knowledge conflict, situations where the backbone language model's parametric knowledge contradicts the evidence it encounters, or where two contextual sources disagree, we evaluate two conflict settings: (1) controlled conflict and (2) naturally occurring conflict during multi-step agentic execution, each paired with matched no-conflict controls. Evaluating four agents, we find that higher task accuracy does not necessarily correspond to greater epistemic humility: some high-accuracy configurations recognize conflicts during execution but do not communicate unresolved uncertainty in their incorrect final answers. Trajectory-level analysis further reveals that agents frequently detect conflicts in early steps of execution but fail to maintain or resolve them in later steps. Finally, we show that model-level interventions can improve EH, but often at the cost of task accuracy, suggesting that epistemic humility emerges from the interaction among the backbone model, agent harness, and evaluation environment.
papers.summary_en: The paper measures conflict identification, follow-up tool use and explicit uncertainty in failed answers across five agent configurations. Claude Code has 55.2% BrowseComp accuracy and 90.0% Identify F1, yet 0% Escalate on errors. A humility prompt often raises escalation while accuracy falls. These are descriptive patterns: task pools differ, model and harness are confounded, human-judge agreement is modest, and appendix definitions conflict. Solve measures action, not successful resolution.
papers.summary_zh:
代理最後答對，是否就代表它妥善處理過程中的矛盾？這篇研究把「認知謙遜」拆成辨識缺口、採取後續查證，以及在答錯時向使用者說明具體不確定性三項行為。作者以受控知識衝突和 GAIA、MoNaCo、BrowseComp 的自然任務，測試四種代理框架、五組骨幹配置，並保留中途軌跡與最終回答的不同判讀範圍。

結果顯示準確率與謙遜不能互相替代。例如 Claude Code 在 BrowseComp 的衝突組準確率為五十五點二，Identify F1 為九十，但錯答的 Escalate 為零。加入謙遜提示後，OpenHands 在 MoNaCo 的 Escalate 由一點六升至六十點七，準確率卻由三十點一降至二十三點二；這是表列描述，並非提示效果的顯著性檢驗。

限制相當重要：自然衝突組與對照組不是相同題目，骨幹和框架沒有交叉控制；Solve 衡量後續工具行動而非成功解題。人工多數決與裁判僅有七成至七成二一致，且附錄對泛稱不確定、模型版本及替代裁判嚴格程度的敘述互有矛盾。早期答案字串出現也不能證明代理已辨識衝突後又遺忘。研究提供有用的診斷方向，但還不足以建立能力越強越不謙遜的因果定律。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A practical, tightly relevant selection heuristic with stronger task evidence than a purely conceptual proposal. The same-count random-layer baseline is important: reducing the adaptation budget alone explains some retention, while cosine selection gives additional gains in the printed math results. However, the theoretical result only lower-bounds empirical Fisher under nonzero task sensitivity and a suitable local parameter direction; its coefficient varies by layer. It proves neither cross-layer order nor protection of an unrelated capability. Commonsense retention is not comprehensive general retention, and Mistral remains substantially below Base. Averaging pass@1/5/10 describes a chosen summary of correlated code metrics; Llama-3-8B pass@1 is53.2 versus53.4 for LoRA and55.1 for Base. Missing uncertainty and implementation details leave the small target gains and performance-cost trade-off provisional. Complete source text supports this bounded assessment without a missing-material hold.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 這是實用且高度相關的選層啟發式，任務證據比概念提案更扎實。同數量隨機選層很重要：少更新幾層本身已解釋部分保留提升，而印刷數學結果仍支持餘弦選層有額外效果。不過理論只在任務敏感度非零且存在適當局部參數方向等條件下給出經驗 Fisher 下界，係數隨層而變，不能推出跨層排序，更不能保證不相干能力受到保護。常識保留不等於全面能力保留，Mistral 仍遠低於 Base。將 pass@1、5、10 平均只是相關指標的摘要；Llama-3-8B 的 pass@1 為五十三點二，低於全層 LoRA 的五十三點四及 Base 的五十五點一。缺不確定性及實作細節，使小幅任務提升與效能成本仍須保守看待。全文完整足以形成此有界評審，不因外部缺件全面扣留。

primary_link.title: Where to Adapt Matters: Layer-Selective Fine-Tuning for Capability Retention

papers.summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables large language models (LLMs) to adapt to specialized tasks, but often at the cost of degrading general capabilities acquired during pretraining. Existing approaches primarily mitigate this trade-off through data replay or regularization, relying on additional data or explicit optimization constraints. We instead focus on a different question: where should adaptation be applied? We find that fine-tuning different Transformer layers produces different target-task gains and degrees of capability degradation, suggesting that not all layers are equally suitable for adaptation. To characterize this difference, we use layer-wise empirical Fisher information to measure target-task sensitivity. However, computing Fisher scores requires backward computation and becomes increasingly expensive for large models. We therefore introduce input--output cosine similarity as a lightweight, forward-only proxy for ranking layer sensitivity. Across models and tasks, layers with lower input--output similarity consistently exhibit higher empirical Fisher scores. Building on this observation, we propose Layer-Selective LoRA (LS-LoRA), which places trainable LoRA adapters only in layers with low input--output similarity. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that LS-LoRA improves average target-task performance while retaining substantially more commonsense reasoning capability than standard all-layer LoRA, demonstrating that carefully choosing where to adapt can provide a simple and effective way to balance target-task adaptation and general capability retention.
papers.summary_en: LS-LoRA uses 100 calibration inputs to select layers with input-output cosine similarity below 0.85, then trains adapters only there. Across four models, reported math gains over full-layer LoRA are 0.4-1.1 points, with 6.0-14.3-point gains on three commonsense tests. Same-count random-layer controls support the criterion. Retention remains incomplete; code pass@1 is not uniformly improved. The Fisher bound is conditional and does not prove layer ranking, while seeds and key training details are missing.
papers.summary_zh: 語言模型為數學或程式任務微調後，常會犧牲原有能力。LS-LoRA 把問題轉成先決定哪些 Transformer 層值得更新：用一百個訓練輸入做前向運算，比較各層最後有效詞元的輸入、輸出餘弦相似度，只在低於零點八五的層放置可訓練適配器，骨幹保持凍結。四個一至八十億參數模型的結果顯示，相較全層 LoRA，數學平均成績增加零點四至一點一個百分點，三個常識測驗的平均保留成績增加六至十四點三個百分點；同數量隨機選層對照也多支持相似度準則。不過「一般能力」實際只用三個常識基準衡量，Mistral 的保留成績仍大幅低於未微調模型。程式結果的總平均混合了三種相關的 pass@k，不能視為三個獨立任務，而且八十億模型的 pass@1 並未改善。附錄把相似度連到經驗 Fisher 的條件式下界，但各層常數不同，並未證明必然排序或不遺忘。方法簡單且有省時、省記憶體數據；仍需補多種子、閾值敏感度、實際選層清單及完整訓練與解碼設定，才能判斷小幅任務增益是否穩健。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A highly relevant but early context-to-weights result. The credible contribution is a reusable hypernetwork trunk that can be fitted to a much larger frozen target and improve teacher-forced document likelihood within its training range. Teacher forcing exposes the true prefix, so the paper's wording about an adapter being the only document source must not be read as an autonomous reconstruction experiment. Base and adapter also differ in chat formatting and approximately 1.5% of scored tokens. The reported 84.9/97.8 averages are descriptive macro-averages over overlapping document-length evaluations, not independent task success rates. Main-task QA, code, full-context-plus-adapter accuracy, actual latency and economic savings are future work. The 64-token warm-start comparison supports transfer per large-model step but excludes small-model pretraining from a matched compute budget. The 16k failures and missing ablations materially temper the score. Complete source access allows a bounded review; it does not validate every empirical or deployment claim.

primary_link.title: Internalizer: Portable Context-to-Parameter Mapping for Very Large Language Models

papers.summary: Hypernetworks that map a context directly to a LoRA adapter let a large language model carry that context in its weights, but prior work has demonstrated them only on base models of up to 14 billion parameters. We present the Internalizer, a state-of-the-art, portable Context-to-Parameter Mapping hypernetwork that generates document-specific LoRA adapters for the frozen 284B-parameter DeepSeek v4 Flash, a target two orders of magnitude larger than in any previous work. Most of its parameters live in a model-agnostic trunk with only thin entry and exit layers per base model, so it trains cheaply against small models before being ported to the large one. On unseen documents of up to 4096 tokens, the generated adapters reach 84.9% top-1 and 97.8% top-5 teacher-forced accuracy against 63.4% and 83.5% for the base model, with nothing in the context window but a three-word instruction. Once the hypernetwork is trained, a single forward pass turns any document into an adapter for such a model, which could be served alone for speed or alongside the document in the window to raise accuracy further.
papers.summary_en: Internalizer maps documents to LoRA adapters using a shared hypernetwork trained on small models and ported to a reported 284B target. Up to 4096 tokens, mean teacher-forced top-1 accuracy is 84.9% versus 63.4%; this supplies the true preceding tokens and does not measure free-running reconstruction or task success. At 16384 tokens it falls below the base model. A 64-token transfer study supports portability, but downstream gains, serving speed and total-compute savings remain untested.
papers.summary_zh: Internalizer 嘗試把文件轉成可重用的 LoRA 權重，減少每次查詢都把相同文字塞入提示的需求。它先讀取凍結語言模型的各層活動，以共享 Perceiver 主幹產生逐區塊適配器，只替不同骨幹重學較薄的輸入、輸出映射；作者先在五個小模型訓練，再移植到所報告的二千八百四十億參數模型。文件每增加一塊，LoRA 秩便增加，並非固定容量的無損壓縮。在三組英文文件、五個不超過四千零九十六詞元的長度組中，逐詞教師強制評估的平均首選準確率為百分之八十四點九，基礎模型為六十三點四。這是已提供正確前文時的下一詞預測，不能當成自由生成全文的重建率，更不是問答或程式任務成功率。超出訓練長度後優勢快速消失，一萬六千三百八十四詞元時甚至明顯劣於基線。小型移植對照支持共享主幹有用，但只測六十四詞元；未提供等總算力的成本比較、推論延遲或主要設計消融。論文的價值是把上下文參數化推至更大模型的原型，實際應用、可攜範圍與經濟效益仍待驗證。

links.title: Learning to Plan by Looking Back: Hindsight Hierarchies for Training Reasoning Models

evidence: PDF pp.1–3: all three roles share parameters; hindsight produces detailed then coarse ideas, foresight predicts coarse then detailed, solver conditions on the hierarchy. The method trains the hindsight generator itself on retained triples. Empirical evaluation is explicitly future work.

PDF pp.4–8, Figures 2/3 and Algorithm 1: theta is frozen while constructing a batch of triples, then all roles are jointly updated with replay. Direct augmentation does not require a verifier. Figure 2 texts are explicitly handwritten illustrations, not model observations.

PDF pp.8–11 Algorithm 2: Score = Utility minus lambda times Penalty, and acceptance requires positive delta. In Lean, Utility is zero with no successful search and otherwise success fraction plus eta/mean tactic count; the retained solution is the shortest discovered valid proof, possibly different from the reference.

PDF p.11: Penalty sums ReLU of coarse length minus alpha times finer length in characters. Since it is nonnegative and delta is positive, a zero-success candidate cannot be accepted even though its internal fallback returns the valid reference. This is a validity property under assumptions, not a self-improvement theorem.

PDF pp.11–12: a proof of k tactics and hierarchy depth n gives 2n+k+2 supervised pairs. Per-response token-normalized loss and balanced role/level groups avoid raw long-text dominance. With n=1 and bS=8,bF=bH=2 the batch is 16, weighting solver/foresight/hindsight by .5/.25/.25; longer proofs still supply more solver examples.

PDF pp.12–13: authors acknowledge hindsight ideas may not be suitable foresight targets and the solver can ignore them. They request future budget-matched SFT baselines and ablations. There are no reported benchmark gains or comparison results.

PDF p.15 Appendix A.1/A.2: internlm2-math-plus-7b at revision 2565e424cc6f83358e7a5aa19b639205fcdd173d; Lean 4.10.0/LeanDojo2.1.3; mathlib revision a719ba5c3115d47b68bf0497a9dd1bcbb21ea663. Reported 50,523 verified training pairs split into 15,000 seed and 35,523 subsequent; 2,000 each reserved validation/test are not evaluated outcomes.

PDF pp.15–18: gpt-5.4-mini is specified only for seed hierarchy generation; later hierarchies use the updated shared model. Anti-hindsight bias is addressed by instructions, not a semantic enforcement test. Solver prompts permit deviation from imperfect plans.

PDF pp.19–20 Appendix A.4–A.6: inference uses two hierarchy arms, optionally a separate null arm, 100 expansions/600 nominal seconds per arm and 32 deterministic tactic beams. Proposed hierarchy assessment uses K=4, N=1, 20 expansions/120 nominal seconds; repeated identical deterministic searches would be redundant. These are settings, not measured runtime or success.

PDF pp.20–21: eta=1, alpha=.5, lambda=.001, delta=.5; success with k tactics yields 1+1/k. Up to three passes of the reserved pool, at most 54 batches; replay takes equal new and historical counts and no accepted triples means no update. U(D)=max(ceil(|D|/2),ceil(NS(D)/8)); seed count42,397 implies7,500 proposed updates, not a reported completed training run.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A precise and relevant methods specification whose research value is a testable training architecture, not a measured advance in reasoning. Explicitly updating the hindsight generator with the same shared backbone is the main distinction from related retrospective-supervision systems. Verifier-guided selection does preserve valid discovered solutions when the stated verifier and tactic restrictions hold; zero-success candidates cannot pass the positive threshold. Neither this invariant nor a shorter hierarchy establishes that the plan caused success, was semantically good, or can be predicted without seeing the answer. The concrete Lean setup uses one deterministic search per hierarchy, not repeated randomized trials, and the paper explicitly defers all empirical evaluation. Formal detail merits a moderate rigor score while empirical evidence remains very low. Full PDF completeness supports assessment of this proposal without a missing-material hold; it does not justify claims of trained-model gains, confirmed software availability or real-world generalization.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 這是一份精確且相關的方法規格，研究價值在可檢驗的訓練架構，尚非已量測的推理進展。與相關事後監督系統的主要差異，是同一共享骨幹也持續更新事後構想生成器。若驗證器與 tactic 限制成立，驗證引導篩選確實保留求解器找到的有效解答；零成功候選無法通過正門檻。但這個不變量與較短構想都不證明構想造成成功、語意良好或能不看答案就預測。具體 Lean 設定每組構想只做一次確定性搜尋，並非多次隨機試驗；論文明確把所有實證評估留待未來。形式細節值得中等偏高嚴謹性評價，實證支持仍很低。完整 PDF 足以評估這項提案，無需缺件暫緩，但不能據此宣稱模型能力提升、軟體可取得或真實泛化。

primary_link.title: Learning to Plan by Looking Back: Hindsight Hierarchies for Training Reasoning Models

papers.summary: We introduce a self-improvement loop for reasoning models based on the following observation: Even when the difficulty of a problem exceeds the model's current solving abilities, an additionally supplied solution might enable the model to extract useful solution ideas in hindsight. We operationalize this by jointly training the same model to exhibit the following three capabilities: predicting solution ideas from problems alone, reverse-engineering ideas from problems and known solutions, and solving problems using provided ideas. The loop alternates between reverse engineering such ideas from problems with supplied solutions and using these ideas as additional supervision for joint training of all three capabilities. We give a formal specification of our method and a concrete instantiation for interactive theorem proving in the Lean theorem prover; empirical evaluation remains future work.
papers.summary_en: This methods proposal jointly trains one model to infer plans from solved examples, predict plans from problems, and solve with them. Coarse-to-fine foresight reverses fine-to-coarse hindsight. A Lean specification selects verified solutions guided by candidate hierarchies, but the paper reports no empirical evaluation. Its concrete setup uses four hierarchies and one deterministic search each. Verification certifies proofs, not useful plans; gains, causal plan use and transfer remain untested.
papers.summary_zh:
看過解答後整理思路，可能比從零想出解法容易。這篇方法論提案把這個直覺轉成三種共享參數的任務：由題目預測構想、由題目與已知解答反推構想，以及依照構想解題。事後模組先抽取詳細計畫，再壓縮成粗略策略；事前模組反向展開，從策略逐步細化。每輪以目前模型產生的新三元組，搭配舊資料重播，共同訓練三個角色。

在可驗證領域，作者另設計候選篩選：讓求解器只看題目與構想，不看參考解答，再按成功情形、證明長度與層級壓縮懲罰挑選。Lean 版本提供雙層提示、最佳優先搜尋、固定模型和資料版本，以及批次與最佳化細節。具體起始配置每題產生四組構想，各做一次確定性搜尋；不能把它說成已用多次隨機實驗估計成功率。

最重要的是，本版明確沒有實證評估。五萬零五百二十三筆是文中報告的已驗證訓練來源，一萬五千筆種子與三萬五千五百二十三筆後續資料也不是測試成績。正確證明只保證解答有效，不能證明構想幫了忙、能由題目預測，或具有可轉移的語意。防止事後偏誤主要靠提示，壓縮懲罰只看字元數；共享模型自我模仿是否改進，仍須同算力基線、移除構想與角色消融來驗證。

evidence: PDF pp.3–4 Eqs.1–5: a fixed-parameter LLM forecasts median reference-relative gain of a complete intervention; BPB gain is reference minus candidate, accuracy gains are percentage points, and histories are supplied in context. No RWM parameter training is demonstrated.
PDF p.5 Table 1: nine environment rows sum exactly to 2,653 records and 171,862 H100 GPU-hours. Five in-env and five cross-env panels overlap at OLMo3-100M; these are not ten distinct environments.

PDF pp.2,6 Table 2: reported unrounded mean Spearman .506 to .774 gives +.268, rounded to +.27. The printed row values give .506 to .776 because rows were rounded; raw forecasts are unavailable and this is not silently treated as a contradiction.

PDF pp.5–6,17 Tables 3/7: cross-env uses 244 source records and 71 target candidates in 69 semantic groups. Test interventions and near-duplicate groups are excluded from source records. Bootstrap intervals versus W0 contain zero for OLMo3-190M [−.07,.18] and Marin [−.05,.24]. OLMo3-190M MAE worsens .00794 to .00856 despite higher Spearman.

PDF pp.6–7,18 Tables 4/5: choose three of 16 from 200 shared random partitions. Qwen3 Regret@3 .00094 to .00021 is about 77.66% from rounded values, consistent with the abstract 78%. Marin regret .00074 to .00079 and NDCG .74 to .70 worsen; in-env inference regret 2.53 exceeds kNN 1.62 and ridge 2.09.
