primary_link.title: TaReD: Tool-Aware Recursive Decomposition for Long-Horizon Tasks

papers.summary: Agents combine reasoning with tools to interact with external systems and complete real-world tasks. Early agents typically interleave reasoning and actions along a single execution chain. On complex tasks, this chain becomes unreliable because growing histories obscure intermediate dependencies and allow early planning errors to propagate. Recursively decomposing a complex task into smaller subtasks offers a natural solution, yet effective decomposition must account for the system's capabilities so that each subtask can be executed by the available tools. In realistic systems, however, tool libraries can be too large to expose in full. Injecting every tool description consumes substantial context while making relevant tools harder to retrieve and useful task boundaries harder to identify. We propose tool-aware recursive decomposition, which organizes tools by functional relationships into a hierarchy of capabilities. During execution, the agent discovers tools on demand and uses the hierarchy to recursively decompose a complex task into a subtask tree whose levels are aligned with the capabilities required at each stage. Experiments on complex real-world tasks show that the proposed method improves end-to-end task success rate by up to 40 percentage points over the compared baselines. The implementation of TaReD is available on GitHub: https://github.com/WeiXiang-Mao/TaReD.
papers.summary_en: TaReD couples a capability tree with recursive planning, delayed tool contracts and reference-based handoffs. On AppWorld Test-C with GPT-5.6 Luna, task completion is 69.3%, versus 51.3% for the strongest baseline and 58.7% for expandable flat discovery. The headline 40-point gain is against the weakest baseline. One model, one seed, unspecified adopted task counts and no uncertainty intervals limit inference; selective tool exposure does not establish lower total cost.
papers.summary_zh:
長程代理不只要選對工具，也得把任務拆成環境真正能執行的步驟。TaReD 將 AppWorld 的 457 個工具整理成能力樹，讓代理按需瀏覽功能摘要，再遞迴拆解任務；細部參數契約延後到執行前才讀取，跨子任務則以穩定參照傳遞必要結果。附錄說明分類樹先由 AI 協助整理，再以固定建構器驗證，每項 API 只有一個主要歸屬。

在 AppWorld Test-C、同用 GPT-5.6 Luna 與相同時間及步數上限的比較中，TaReD 任務全通過率為 69.3%，高於 ReAct 的 51.3%、ADAPT 的 46.7%及 Plan-and-Solve 的 29.3%。因此「最多提升四十個百分點」是相對最弱基準；相對最強基準是十八點。同一遞迴框架下，可擴充平面工具集達 58.7%，仍低於能力樹，支持結構化探索的實用價值。

但結果僅涵蓋單一模型、環境與固定種子，沒有重複試驗區間，亦未清楚列出採用任務數。工具曝光比例及每次決策的上下文量不等於總成本，建樹與額外探索的時間仍待量化。這是一個值得測試的工具組織方案，尚不能視為普遍可靠或低成本的保證。

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 與工具代理、自我改進、長期上下文及軟體工程高度相關。價值在於把異質元件版本、實際呼叫、保留決策與後續使用連成可查核的系統契約，並清楚區分元件進步和任務成功。方法與失敗語義描述詳細，六案例保留回滾、未完成和負策略結果，有助於校準工程主張。但主要SWE數字是未提供逐題原始包、實際配置及成本的團隊報告，不能做配對顯著性檢定或歸因；外部排行榜條件不匹配。案例是目的性選取、常由建構代理自評、部分元件類型由任務指定，且僅五類有後續使用證據。Godot各三次呼叫的局部速度差不能泛化為遊戲效能，Signal Foundry最終資料隔離亦未強制落實。未取得程式庫、證據索引與manifest限制獨立稽核；完整PDF仍足以評析設計及上述限制，故採保守證據與泛化分數，不把未做的C.3–C.4實驗寫成成果。

scope_assessment.reason: Fixed-model language-agent software adaptation, runtime coordination and source-bound capability evaluation; application cases do not make it a pure domain paper.

primary_link.title: AgentEvolver: System-Wide Self-Evolution Through Task Execution

papers.summary: An agent can complete a task without improving how it works. Turning task experience into reusable capability requires connecting the changed component to its evaluation and subsequent use. We present AgentEvolver, a system for developing capabilities during task execution while keeping the foundation model fixed. Eight entity families expose reusable operations, methods, agents, control flow, interfaces, and supporting state to revision through a common versioned lifecycle. A shared Runtime coordinates ongoing work, while persistent planning and recoverable context preserve task direction and supporting evidence. We evaluate task outcomes on SWE-bench Pro Public and examine capability changes in six application cases. The team reports an 82.08\% resolution rate with evolution, exceeding its reported baseline without evolution. The cases show retained capabilities entering later website, game, and research work, while also documenting incomplete objectives and an unsuccessful strategy. These findings distinguish improvement in a reusable component from success on the final task. AgentEvolver provides a concrete basis for studying capability accumulation through execution; independent-task transfer and total development cost remain open questions.
papers.summary_en: AgentEvolver keeps the foundation model fixed while versioning eight families of reusable capabilities. It separates admission, evaluation, retention and later use. The team reports 600/731 versus 578/731 SWE-bench Pro tasks solved, but raw paired outcomes, realized settings and costs are unavailable. Six selected cases show task-local reuse across five families, including incomplete objectives and a failed strategy. Independent-task transfer and development-cost payback remain unproven.
papers.summary_zh:
AgentEvolver 問的是：代理完成任務後，能否留下真正用得上的新能力？它固定基礎模型，讓工具、技能、代理、工作流程、連接器、環境、記憶與外掛八類元件共用版本管理、執行紀錄及保留流程。重點是分清「可以載入」「測試通過」「決定保留」與「後續真的使用」，並以共用 Runtime、持續計畫及可回查的上下文支援尚未完成的工作。

團隊回報 SWE-bench Pro Public 開啟演化後解決 600／731 題，未開啟時為 578／731 題，約增加 3.01 個百分點。但論文沒有該次外部執行的逐題結果、實際配置與完整成本，表列模型及預算只是目前設定，不能據此認定顯著提升或優於其他模型。六個歷史案例則提供較具體的局部改進：例如 Godot 亮度診斷在同一真實影格、各三次呼叫下，中位延遲降低 30.08%，這不是遊戲幀率的增益。

案例也保留未完成和負結果：ORBITAL 缺少必要的審查技能，遊戲尚未全部交付，量化策略未達比較優勢。實證涵蓋五類元件及同專案後續使用，未證明八類全面改善、獨立任務轉移或開發成本能回收。本文適合當作自演化代理的系統設計與證據紀錄參考，而非成熟效益保證。

llm_evaluation.rationale: The paper closely matches tool-using language agents, reasoning budgets and RL evaluation. Separating wall-clock adherence from productive use, and documenting invalid actions that satisfy time rewards, has direct engineering value. Clocks, command enforcement and GRPO provide layered diagnostics; 16-episode Zork cells and budget curves support observations in this setting. Novelty lies mainly in diagnosis and comparison. MLE Table 2 quality drops from 49.4±4.4 to 42.1±1.8, conflicting with the prose values 47.5 to 47.0 and its no-measurable-loss claim; the RL quality cell is blank. The five-competition table caption conflicts with the appendix excluding dogs-vs-cats. Mid-run reward and hard-stop changes further limit causal attribution. Fixed-start Zork encourages memorization, and ±15% matching or the reward plateau is not strict punctuality. Test labels are readable with only a prompt prohibition, a contamination risk rather than evidence that leakage occurred. Full prompts, equations and hyperparameters aid reconstruction, but exact code, trajectories and MLE sample statistics remain unavailable here. This is a useful bounded negative-result and design study, not a demonstrated solution to general time planning.

primary_link.title: On the Clock: Towards Punctual and Productive Time-Budgeted AI Agents

papers.summary: We study whether small LLM agents can operate effectively under explicit wall-clock time budgets by both respecting the allocated runtime and using available time productively. We evaluate Qwen3.6-27B on five competitions from MLE-Bench Lite and Qwen3-4B on Zork I (Jericho), two agentic benchmarks where additional computational time can meaningfully improve performance. In the simplest setting, where the budget is stated only in the prompt, agents fail to translate the stated budget into controlled use of time. These failures arise from gaps in time awareness, since the harness provides no timing feedback, but also because they cannot reliably anticipate the duration of actions, and do not have a learned mapping from available time to an appropriate strategy. We investigate two complementary classes of interventions: harness-based mechanisms that expose timing information and enforce deadlines, and reinforcement learning with budget-aware rewards. Injecting timing information through the harness substantially improves budget adherence for Qwen3.6-27B without measurable loss in performance, while enforcement hooks tighten adherence further. RL with GRPO achieves near-perfect budget adherence on Zork I and generalizes to held-out budgets not seen during training, but does not improve task performance over the untrained harness on MLE-Bench. Once agents are made to respect the budget, they still fail to use additional time to improve task performance. RL-trained policies learn when to stop but often fill extra time with repeated actions, and GRPO training on multiple budgets tends to collapse toward the strategy learned for the shortest budget. Our results reveal a gap between time adherence and productive time allocation, which remains a central challenge for budget-conditioned agents.
papers.summary_en: On the Clock separates deadline adherence from productive use of time. In MLE-Bench, clock feedback cuts mean runtime from 1453 to 897 seconds for a 900-second budget. Zork RL improves short-budget scores but longer runs repeat invalid actions rather than make progress. The evidence is limited by a fixed game, inconsistent MLE quality figures and an unreported RL quality score. The practical lesson is to measure useful actions and outcome quality separately from time consumed.
papers.summary_zh:
準時結束與善用時間，是語言代理的兩種不同能力。這篇研究在 MLE-Bench 的機器學習任務及文字冒險遊戲 Zork I，比較只在提示中寫明期限、加入時鐘回饋、攔截超時工具，以及以 GRPO 訓練時間獎勵。重點不只是更快，而是增加預算後能否做出更好的成果。

表二顯示，十五分鐘預算下，提示組平均耗時1453秒；加入時鐘後降至897秒，準時比例從15%升至62%，拒絕過長命令後達88%。但正文稱品質幾乎不變，與表中49.4降至42.1的百分位數不一致，不能直接照單全收。在 Zork，四百步訓練後，自動時鐘策略於十六秒取得46.4／350分，主動查鐘策略為16.6分；這是固定遊戲內的改善。

較長預算未帶來相應進展，代理常重複無效命令耗完時間。時間獎勵項在預算九成至十一成間達上限，更提醒讀者「接近預算」不等於嚴格守時。單一遊戲、有限競賽、缺少 RL 品質數值、表格與文字矛盾及可讀取測試標籤的設計，都限制結論。本文最有價值的啟示，是把截止控制、有效行動與成果品質分開評估，而非把耗時接近上限當作成功。

primary_link.title: Memory Type Varies: Empowering LLM Agents for Long-Term Memory with Diverse Strategies

papers.summary: The memory capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) have garnered increasing attention recently. Despite great success achieved, existing retrieval-based memory approaches typically overlook the differences between memories and employ a unified strategy to process all memories, leading to suboptimal performance. Thus, an intuitive question arises: can we categorize memory into different types and select appropriate strategies? However, given the topic-rich, scenario-complex, and boundary-blurred nature of memory scenarios, achieving precise classification of memories is not easy. To address this challenge, we propose a memory multi-class dataset in this paper, termed TriMEM, which provides precise annotations for memory types across diverse scenarios. Building upon this foundation, we propose a novel memory framework, named MemoType, which can adaptively recognize each memory and query type with the learned router model. With the memory and query routing, MemoType can retrieve the memory with corresponding query types and design tailored retrieval strategies, thereby enhancing the retrieval performance. Moreover, we theoretically prove that any single retrieval strategy is subject to a fundamental upper bound on its expected retrieval precision in multi-class corpora, leading to systematic precision degradation. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that MemoType consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to 16.18% improvement in Recall@1.
papers.summary_en: MemoType routes dialogue memories into episodic, personal-semantic and general-semantic types, then uses tailored retrieval and pruning. LongMemEval-M Recall@1 rises from 31.91% to 48.09%, a 16.18-point gain. Four benchmark settings and ablations are promising, but dataset counts conflict, a baseline prompt misdefines episodic memory, and the theory bounds average similarity rather than recall. Reported large savings cover limited ingestion API costs, not end-to-end use.
papers.summary_zh:
對話記憶未必適合共用同一種檢索方式。MemoType 將內容分成事件、個人語意與一般語意，以 TriMEM 標註資料訓練小型路由器，再依查詢挑選記憶類型：事件拆成時間、人物等元素，個人資訊由記憶反向生成可能問題，一般知識則以假想記憶擴展查詢，最後再篩去不相關內容。

在四組長期記憶評測中，表一的 Recall@1 均高於列出的基準。LongMemEval-M 從最強已報基準的31.91%提升至48.09%，是16.18個百分點；LongMemEval-S 則是56.99%至59.15%，增幅較小。統一策略、路由、剪枝及替代編碼器的消融，提供這套設計值得實測的理由，但並非每個排名深度都勝出。

可信度仍受重要缺口限制：TriMEM 宣稱六千筆，來源明細卻只合計三千；提示基準誤把事件記憶定義成一般知識，且訓練切分與統計檢定資訊不充分。定理約束的是獨立抽樣的平均相似度，不能據此宣稱單一檢索器必然失敗。百倍費用差距也只涉及特定建庫 API 成本，部分基準採外推，並非端到端成本。應把它看成有潛力的分類檢索方案，待修正矛盾、核對資料與實作後再評估部署。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant LLM-agent diagnosis with a useful separation between error sources, propagation carriers, recovered deviations and final symptoms. The main contribution is a structured two-branch candidate-construction pipeline followed by model-based counterfactual judgment, extending existing graph-guided attribution rather than establishing intervention-based causality. Table 1 reports the strongest step-level results among listed baselines on both Who&When subsets, with a modest +3.45/+4.40 percentage-point margin over CHIEF and 32.76%/50.00% absolute accuracy. Four backbones, length stratification and branch ablations add evidence, but only one benchmark is tested, the 58-log subset is small, three-run variation is not reported, and some baseline values are adopted from different original protocols. Full-versus-single-branch comparisons also change maximum candidate counts from four to two, so they do not isolate structural reasoning at equal search budget. Figure 3 does not support superiority in every length tier and shows only about 11% exact-step accuracy in the longest group. Counterfactual verification is an LLM assessment, not environment replay; alignment with expert labels does not demonstrate successful repairs. The supplied eight-page PDF is complete and supports these bounded descriptive claims. Missing external algorithm details, prompts, configurations and cost analyses materially limit executable reproduction and any efficiency assessment, but do not warrant holding this narrow full-PDF scientific review.

primary_link.title: Error-Propagation Modeling for Failure Attribution in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems

papers.summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MASs) are increasingly used to solve complex tasks through coordinated reasoning, tool use, and interaction with external resources. However, attributing failures in such systems remains challenging because the observed outcome often does not directly reveal the error responsible for the failed execution. In this work, the attribution target is the decisive error, defined as the agent--step pair whose correction would recover the failed execution. Existing approaches largely identify suspicious steps without explicitly modeling how errors propagate across interactions or persist in unresolved loops, making decisive errors difficult to distinguish from downstream failure symptoms. We propose \textbf{E}rror-Propagation \textbf{M}odeling for \textbf{F}ailure \textbf{A}ttribution (\textbf{EMFA}). EMFA constructs a structured representation of the failed trajectory, models both cascading propagation and persistent interaction loops, and uses propagation-aware candidate screening followed by counterfactual verification to identify the decisive agent--step pair. On the Who\&When benchmark, EMFA achieves state-of-the-art step-level attribution accuracy and remains competitive at the agent level. It improves the previous best step-level results by 3.45 and 4.40 percentage points on the Hand-Crafted and Algorithm-Generated subsets, respectively.
papers.summary_en: EMFA traces error propagation and unproductive loops, then uses an LLM to judge up to four candidate repairs. On 58/126 Who&When logs, reported exact-step accuracy is 32.76%/50.00%, +3.45/+4.40 points over CHIEF. These are label matches, not replay-verified repairs. Branch ablations also shrink candidate budgets; mixed baseline protocols and absent run variance weaken attribution. Long traces remain hard. External prompts, settings and cost analyses were not obtained, limiting reproduction and efficiency claims.
papers.summary_zh:
多代理任務失敗時，最後答錯的代理未必是根因。EMFA把目標定為「若修正便能挽救任務的最早代理與步驟」，先從問題建立成功條件、找出最終失敗，再把日誌轉為步驟與子任務的資訊依賴圖。它沿依賴反向追蹤、按時間標記錯誤的引入、傳遞與修正，另找持續無進展的互動迴圈；兩分支各挑至多兩個候選，最後由語言模型評估假想修正。

在Who&When的58份人工設計與126份演算法生成日誌上，GPT-4o版本的精確步驟命中率為32.76%與50.00%，比表中最佳既有方法高3.45與4.40個百分點；代理辨識則只在前者居首。其他三種模型與分支消融提供補充證據，但移除分支也把候選上限從四個降至兩個，因此不能把差距全歸因於傳播或迴圈建模。長軌跡仍很難：最長組步驟命中約11%，並非每種長度都勝過比較方法。

價值在於把根因、傳播載體與最終症狀分開，供代理除錯流程參考。需注意，反事實驗證只是模型判斷，沒有真的重跑環境證明修復成功；三次執行未報變異，部分基線沿用不同原作設定。外部提示詞、設定與成本補件未取得，可評讀本文報告，卻不能據此宣稱已重現或證實部署效益。

llm_evaluation.rationale: The paper separates a scientific agent's endpoint score from its dependence on task descriptions and experimental feedback. Matched finite-budget FNO adaptation, value-preserving notation controls, repeated-prompt baselines and a score-plus-diagnostics intervention make the behavioral result credible within the studied setting. The LLM wins35/36 test comparisons against TPE and36/36 against random search, but its additional inputs and inference cost are unmatched. Replay sensitivity cannot explain the endpoint advantage because counterfactual trajectories are not continued, and the cold-start effect is chiefly one learning-rate coordinate. One hosted model, two1D PDE families and three endpoint seeds restrict generalization. Detailed appendices and external artifact pointers help auditability, while the uninspected code/records and underspecified bootstrap limit independent reproduction. In scope as language-agent evaluation methodology; no claim of rational scientific reasoning, formal admission or publication approval.

primary_link.title: Prior or Feedback? What an LLM Uses When Adapting Neural Operators

papers.summary: Do LLM scientific agents rely only on their initial task context, or do they adapt their decisions in response to experimental feedback? We study this question in neural operator adaptation, where a large language model (LLM) selects fine-tuning configurations under a limited trial budget. Across transfers within and between partial differential equation (PDE) families, the LLM achieves lower held-out test nRMSE than random search and Bayesian optimisation in nearly every matched comparison. Endpoint performance alone cannot distinguish what happens, so we verify each attribution with controlled interventions. Before observing any validation score, the LLM's first configuration already ranks near the top of the corresponding random-search pool, indicating a useful initial bias. A complementary cold-start intervention shows that the selected base learning rate shifts with the PDE description. Once feedback becomes available, reassigning validation scores among evaluated configurations changes the next proposal in every case tested, whereas a value-preserving rewrite produces no comparable aggregate effect. These interventions establish that the LLM's decision-level actions respond to the given task and observed outcomes, showing that it combines a task-dependent prior with sensitivity to experimental feedback.
papers.summary_en:
A scientific agent finding good parameters does not establish that it uses experimental feedback. This paper puts a language model inside a fixed neural-operator adaptation loop. Every trial starts from the same pretrained weights, selects a twelve-dimensional configuration including learning rate, optimizer, rollout length and losses, and returns validation error plus training diagnostics. A single hosted model is evaluated on twelve transfers within and between advection and Burgers equations, with three seeds and twenty evaluations per search policy.

The language-model policy beats random search in all 36 held-out test comparisons and TPE Bayesian optimization in 35 of 36. Available information and inference costs nevertheless differ between policies. Before feedback, the median first proposal already outperforms 91.7% of its cell's pooled random-search candidates on validation error. Switching the displayed equation description shifts the median initial learning rate from 0.0005 to 0.001, demonstrating a text-dependent initial preference.

The authors then keep evaluated configurations fixed and permute which validation scores belong to them. Relative to a value-preserving notation control, the next action moves by a median additional 0.085; all eighteen within-family trace effects are positive. This supports feedback sensitivity, not rationality, physical understanding, or a causal explanation of the endpoint advantage: counterfactual searches are never continued. Evidence is restricted to two one-dimensional PDE families, one model and a small budget. The reusable contribution is an audit that distinguishes endpoint quality from dependence on supplied inputs. Appendices document settings and controls and link code and run records, but those external artifacts were not obtained and no experiments were reproduced here.
papers.summary_zh:
科學代理找到好參數，不代表它真的使用實驗回饋。本文把大型語言模型放入固定的神經算子微調流程：每輪從相同預訓練權重重新開始，選擇學習率、最佳化器、展開長度及損失等十二維設定，再讀取驗證誤差與訓練診斷。研究使用一個託管模型，在平流與 Burgers 方程的十二種轉移情境、各三個種子下，給各搜尋策略二十次評估機會。

測試集結果中，語言模型勝過隨機搜尋36／36次、勝過TPE貝氏最佳化35／36次；但各方法可用資訊與推論成本不同。第一筆提案尚未看見回饋，其驗證表現中位數已勝過同情境隨機候選的91.7%。把提示中的方程描述換掉，初始學習率中位數由0.0005變成0.001，顯示文字會影響先驗選擇。

作者再固定既有設定，打亂驗證分數的配對；相對只改數字寫法的對照，下一個動作的距離增加0.085，十八條軌跡皆為正。這支持代理對回饋有反應，不能證明反應合理、理解物理，或解釋終點優勢，因為反事實搜尋並未繼續執行。實驗限於兩類一維方程、一個模型與小預算；方法的實用價值是將終點成績和輸入敏感度分開稽核。附錄交代設定與控制，並列程式及紀錄連結，但本次未取得外部套件或重現實驗。

primary_link.title: Looking Inside LLMs: Small-World Connectivity as a Signature of Reasoning Performance

papers.summary: Understanding large language model (LLM) reasoning requires looking beyond behavioral performance to examine how reasoning ability is reflected in internal organization. Inspired by neuroscience findings linking higher intelligence to stronger small-world organization in functional brain networks, we investigate small-world connectivity as a structural signature of LLM reasoning. We construct functional graphs from attention-head activation similarities and find that a higher small-world index (SWI), capturing local clustering and short global paths, consistently correlates with better fluid reasoning performance across models and training checkpoints. Since local clustering is central to small-world organization, we further examine how heads important for model performance connect within and across communities. We find that these heads tend to have a larger share of connection weight within their own communities (high core scores) and a more concentrated weight distribution across communities (low bridge scores). These observations motivate the hypothesis that high core and low bridge scores serve as structural indicators of head importance for reasoning capability. We validate this hypothesis through pruning, introducing Small-World Allocation (SWA), a hierarchical sparsity allocation method guided by these scores. Across six LLMs, SWA better preserves small-world organization and model performance than competing allocation strategies, reducing WikiText perplexity by up to 20%. Together, these findings identify small-world functional connectivity as a measurable signature of LLM reasoning performance, offering a structural perspective that complements behavioral evaluation.
papers.summary_en:
Can the organization of attention heads reveal a language model's reasoning performance? The paper constructs functional graphs from query activations on 400 calibration questions. It averages each head's activations over generated answer tokens, retains singular directions explaining 99% of variance, computes canonical correlations between heads, and sums their Fisher-transformed values. The strongest 25% of pairwise similarities define an undirected graph. Its small-world index multiplies clustering and global-efficiency ratios relative to degree-preserving randomized graphs.

Across six Qwen/Llama models and seven Pythia checkpoints, higher index values accompany lower reference-answer negative log-likelihood per token. Figure 3 plots Llama3.2-1B above 1.1, whereas Table 7 reports SWI means of 0.9188 and 0.9344 for the two levels. This discrepancy is unexplained; cross-model SWI quantities here follow Table 7, while the shared rank trend remains. The authors then derive Small-World Allocation (SWA) from within-community connection share and cross-community dispersion. Heads with high core or low bridge scores receive lower pruning priority, with sparsity allocated across both layers and heads. For Qwen3-8B using SparseGPT at 70% sparsity, WikiText perplexity falls from 25.13 for the strongest competing allocator to 20.10, approximately 20%. Layer/head ablations, alternative graph-construction datasets, and zero-shot tasks provide additional support.

Functional correlations are not direct information flow or a causal reasoning mechanism, and answer likelihood is not problem-solving accuracy. The ARAOC evaluation measures output-grid shape mismatch, not full answer correctness, and the pruned model remains worse than its unpruned counterpart. Cross-model comparisons may confound capacity and representation dimensionality; the full density sweep and several implementation settings are unreported. Code is promised for a future release, not verified as available. The contribution is a promising interpretability and pruning-allocation signal, rather than proof that small-world organization causes greater intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
語言模型的推理表現，是否能從注意力頭之間的連結結構看出端倪？本文把四百道校準題中各頭的查詢向量，先沿生成答案的詞元取平均，再用保留99%變異的奇異值分解與典型相關分析，將相關係數經Fisher轉換後加總。保留最強25%邊形成無向功能圖，以相對於保留度數之隨機圖的群聚與全域效率乘積，定義小世界指數。

六個Qwen／Llama模型及Pythia七個訓練檢查點中，較高指數伴隨較低的參考答案逐詞元負對數似然。圖3的Llama3.2-1B點高於1.1，表7兩級均值卻為0.9188及0.9344，差異未解；跨模型SWI數值依表7。作者再用社群內連結占比及跨社群分散程度設計SWA，讓高核心、低橋接分數的頭承受較少剪枝，並分層配置稀疏度。在Qwen3-8B、SparseGPT、70%稀疏度下，WikiText困惑度由最強比較法的25.13降至20.10，約改善20%；層級與頭級消融、其他建圖資料及零樣本任務提供補充證據。

然而，功能圖的相關性不是實際訊息傳遞或因果推理機制，答案似然也不等於解題正確率。ARAOC只檢查輸出網格形狀，不代表內容答對；結果仍不及未剪枝模型。跨模型比較可能混入容量與表徵維度差異，密度選擇的完整掃描及多項實作細節未報，程式碼僅承諾未來釋出。此研究值得作為可解釋性與剪枝配置的探索性線索，尚不足以證明小世界結構造成更強智慧。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A relevant, moderately novel audit combines legal-target swaps, latent-answer readouts, and prompt injection. Gold-different controls and extensive aggregate tables make the behavioral warning useful: instructed citation alone does not establish reliable target-dependent decisions. Scientific weight is moderate. Raw injection compliance must be separated from baseline-changing reversals, CaseHOLD measures precedent-name dispensability, and textual re-engagement cannot certify a causal mechanism or a strict mechanistic lower bound. Table 7 supplies an exception to the universal naming/re-engagement-gap claim. Thirty-case cells, smaller usable subsets, a single seed, mostly non-significant corrected rankings, inconsistent probe methods, and an inexact legal-model merge limit inference. Missing code, exact prompts and per-case data limit reproducibility, not the completeness of this eighteen-page PDF. In scope for reasoning-faithfulness and evaluation methods; no claim of legal-system readiness or formal admission.

primary_link.title: Cited but Not Consulted: A Counterfactual Audit of Legal Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness

papers.summary: Large language models increasingly justify legal decisions by naming the statute or precedent behind a verdict, treated as evidence that the decision follows from it. We test this directly: holding case facts fixed, we substitute the named legal authority for an unrelated one and decode a model's evolving verdict from its hidden states. Across seven open-weight models (8B-70B) and four benchmarks spanning judicial and contractual reasoning, when explicitly required to justify a verdict by naming the governing authority, models name the correct one in 66.7%-100% of generations, while the verdict changing when the authority changes is far less consistent: 0.0%-21.7% on CaseHOLD, 30.0%-76.7% on ECHR and SCOTUS, and 43.3%-50.0% on ContractNLI. Neither scale nor a purpose-built legal-reasoning model (a best-effort LoRA reproduction; Section 6) closes this gap. A red-teaming evaluation on five core models finds compliance with an adversarial instruction hidden in the case facts (73.3%-96.4%) exceeds verdict-swap sensitivity by a wide margin, holding without exception across model rankings. Naming a legal authority is thus a poor proxy for a verdict's dependence on it, while the same verdict remains separately vulnerable to adversarial manipulation. Both findings replicate across checks ruling out prompt-wording noise and confounded sampling, and bear directly on the use of generated legal explanations as compliance or audit artefacts.
papers.summary_en:
Does naming a statute or precedent in a legal explanation mean the decision actually depends on it? This paper holds case facts fixed, substitutes the legal decision target, and compares the resulting verdicts. It also reads hidden states at sentence boundaries to estimate when an answer stabilizes and whether the target is mentioned again afterward. Seven models and four datasets are covered, but not in a complete factorial design. Main experimental cells use thirty cases and one fixed seed.

For six models on ECHR Pair A, verdict-swap sensitivity is 31.0%–58.6%, versus naming rates of 80%–100%. The more informative restriction requires the two targets to have different gold labels: ContractNLI sensitivity remains only 50.0%–66.7% among ten to twelve usable cases. CaseHOLD merely replaces a precedent name with a placeholder; its 0%–21.7% change rate can reflect a redundant name rather than unfaithful reasoning. Across five models, 73.3%–96.4% of injected outputs match the attacker's requested verdict, but only 18.5%–41.4% change from the uninjected baseline. These are distinct outcomes, not interchangeable attack-induced reversal rates.

The useful contribution is an audit that separates citation, behavioral dependence, and mechanistic evidence. Sentence-boundary probes and repeated name strings are not causally validated and cannot establish that a model ignored the authority; zero pre-naming commitments may reflect a measurement floor. Small samples, wide intervals, a substituted base for the legal-model adapter, and unavailable code and per-case outputs limit the conclusions. Table 7 also contains a model with both naming and re-engagement at 100%, contradicting an unqualified claim that this gap never closes. The defensible lesson is that fluent citation alone is insufficient evidence of faithful reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
模型在法律解釋中說出法條或判例，是否代表判斷真的依據它？本文固定案件事實，替換問題中的法律判斷目標，再比較判決是否改變；另於每句結尾讀取隱藏狀態，估計答案穩定時點及其後是否再次提及目標。研究涵蓋七個模型與四項資料集，但並非所有模型都跑完整組合；主要每格三十例，固定單一種子。

ECHR第一組六模型的判決替換敏感度為31.0%–58.6%，命名率則80%–100%。更有意義的是限定兩目標正解不同：ContractNLI可用十至十二例的敏感度仍僅50.0%–66.7%。CaseHOLD只把判例名稱改成佔位名稱，0%–21.7%的變動可能反映名稱冗餘，不能直接當不忠實。五模型注入指令後輸出吻合指定判決達73.3%–96.4%，但相對未注入基線真正改判僅18.5%–41.4%，兩者不可混稱攻擊翻案率。

本文適合提醒讀者區分引用、判斷依賴與機制證據。句界探針及字串再提及未經因果驗證，不能證明模型沒使用法律依據；零次提前定案也可能是量測下限。樣本小、信賴區間寬，法律模型使用替代基底合併，程式與逐例輸出未取得。表7更有命名與再提及均100%的例外，不宜照抄「差距從未閉合」；較可信的結論是單靠流暢引用不足以稽核忠實性。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A relevant audit contribution: the paper jointly reports behavioral rule sensitivity and a compliance-projection shift, showing that high original-label accuracy can coexist with largely unchanged verdicts. Its five-model audit, bias-aware null and deletion-critical control are useful, and the authors document important limitations. The central 300-character truncation, completeness/instruction confound, transferred model partitions and absence of perturbed-rule gold labels prevent interpreting low OCS as blanket rule neglect or legal reasoning failure. ICS-delta measures one direction, not all rule information; lack of significant convergence does not establish independence. Prompting/steering tests report accuracy, not recovered grounding, and steering significance is nominal across 16 comparisons. External OCS is 3–4 times higher and tested on only one model; the repurposed guard's chance accuracy is format-specific. Useful in-scope LLM evaluation and interpretability work with moderate evidence, limited reproducibility and no demonstrated reliable repair.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本篇有價值的稽核貢獻，是並列行為規則敏感度與合規投影變化，呈現原標籤高正確率仍可伴隨幾乎不變的裁決。五模型、偏態虛無參考與刪除敏感控制有用，作者也明列重要限制。核心300字元截斷、完整性／指令混淆、跨模型套用分組，以及缺少擾動規則正解，使低OCS不能直接判成全面忽視規則或法律推理失敗。ICS-delta只量單一方向，不是全部規則資訊；未顯著收斂亦不證明獨立。提示與steering實驗量正確率而非依據修復，十六steering比較僅名目顯著。外部OCS高三至四倍且只測一個模型；改造guard的隨機水準正確率也屬格式特定。依原規準為範圍內LLM評估與可解釋研究，證據中等、重現受限，未展示可靠修復。

scope_assessment.rationale_en: The contribution evaluates language-model rule sensitivity, representation probes and interventions themselves; regulatory tasks provide test cases. This methodological focus satisfies the original LLM/evaluation scope rather than relying on a pure domain application.

primary_link.title: Verdict Without the Rule: Diagnosing and Auditing Regulatory Rule Sensitivity in LLM Compliance Systems

papers.summary: Large language model compliance systems are deployed on the assumption that a verdict depends on the regulatory rule it is given. We test this directly across five models and 20 regulatory and platform-policy domains: delete, swap, or negate the governing rule while holding the case fixed, and check whether the verdict changes (OCS) or the model's internal representation of compliance shifts at all (ICS-delta). Neither moves much: models' verdicts are often invariant to substantial perturbations of the supplied rule, and the guard model, evaluated here under a custom-rule adaptation of its native taxonomy, is the least rule-sensitive and least accurate of the five, barely above chance (51%, versus 90-92% for general-purpose models). This reflects easy cases more than blanket neglect: on cases where deleting the rule changes a previously correct model prediction, models do track it closely. Neither better prompting nor direct intervention on the model's internal representations closes this gap. Accuracy alone does not establish that a compliance verdict is grounded in the supplied rule.
papers.summary_en:
When a compliance model answers correctly, did it use the supplied rule? This paper holds the case fixed, deletes the rule, substitutes one from another domain, or negates mandatory obligations. OCS measures verdict flips; ICS-delta measures the change in activation projected onto a compliance-predictive direction. The main experiment covers five open models and twenty domains, with 3,946 cases and 64,485 case-condition generations. The four general-purpose models achieve approximately 90–92% accuracy while their aggregate OCS is only 0.070–0.094, showing that high accuracy can coexist with low perturbation sensitivity.

This does not establish blanket rule neglect. In model-specific subsets that are initially correct but become incorrect after rule deletion, swapping rules raises flip rates to 0.73–1.00. These subsets are selected by model behavior, not independently annotated legal necessity. Two external datasets, tested only with Llama-70B, produce OCS values of 0.255 and 0.318, also warning against treating the score as task-independent. Prompting and activation steering show no significant accuracy improvement; the evaluation does not directly demonstrate repaired rule grounding.

A central limitation is that the standard prompt retains only the first 300 characters of the rule, whereas the intervention both supplies the full rule and requests a supporting quotation, confounding the changes. OCS tests whether the verdict changes, not whether the change is correct. ICS inspects one direction at one layer, so a small shift cannot establish that rule information is absent elsewhere. The guard model's 51.1% accuracy concerns a custom adaptation outside its native taxonomy, not a general failure of safety training. The paper offers a useful audit warning and starting point, but does not certify real-world regulatory reasoning or an effective repair.
papers.summary_zh:
合規模型答對案例，是否真的依照提供的規則？本文固定案例，刪除規則、換成其他領域的規則，或否定「必須」義務，再以OCS計算裁決翻轉率；另以ICS-delta量測內部活化在合規分類方向上的投影變化。主實驗比較五個開放模型、二十個領域，共3,946個案例及64,485次案例／條件生成。四個通用模型正確率約90–92%，OCS卻只有0.070–0.094，顯示高正確率可與低擾動敏感度並存。

這不代表模型完全忽略規則。挑出「原本答對、刪規則後答錯」的模型特定子集，換規則的翻轉率升至0.73–1.00；這是依模型結果定義，並非法律專家標註的必要規則。外部兩資料集只測Llama-70B，OCS升至0.255與0.318，也說明數值不可直接跨任務套用。改提示或加活化方向，未見顯著正確率提升，並未直接證明規則依據已修復。

最重要的限制是標準提示只保留規則前300字元，而新提示同時補完整規則與要求引述，無法分離效果。OCS只測有沒有改判，不判改得對不對；ICS也只看單層一個方向，低變化不能證明其他位置沒有規則資訊。安全分類器51.1%的結果限於改造其原生分類格式後的任務，不能概括安全訓練無效。本文適合作為多模型稽核方法的警示與起點，尚不足以認證真實法規推理或修復效果。

llm_evaluation.rationale: GRASP is in scope as a general language-model-assisted symbolic program-synthesis method, with executable coverage and fitted two-leaf residual weights grounding the proposer. Fourteen relational task results across three families and two LLM variants show practical promise, but modest baseline coverage and missing split/prompt/code details limit rigor and reproducibility. The one-shot comparison does not isolate residual-guided example selection; reported PR wins include one tie. Figure2 does not establish calibrated probabilities and its Gemini log-loss trend cautions against that reading. Boosting-style descent is conditional, not an unconditional guarantee for arbitrary LLM proposals. Readable rules are useful inspection artifacts, not demonstrated human explainability or causal biomedical knowledge. Recommended as a cautious methodological guide, with no independent reproduction, admission or publication conclusion.

primary_link.title: Learning Probabilistic Logic Programs with Functional Gradient Guided Language Models

papers.summary: Declarative logic programs offer a powerful and interpretable abstraction for encoding relational structure and neurosymbolic reasoning, by expressing dependencies as weighted compositional rules. However, inducing them from data remains fundamentally hard, bottlenecked by the combinatorial explosion of symbolic search spaces. LLMs have recently emerged as powerful hypothesis generators, but when used in isolation, they lack the capacity to do systematic inductive reasoning needed to reliably synthesize valid programs that fit complex relational distributions. We introduce grasp (Gradient-boosted Synthesis of Probabilistic logic programs), a neurosymbolic framework that casts relational structure learning as functional gradient boosting in which the weak learner is a first-order rule and the intractable inner search is delegated to an LLM proposal oracle. We evaluate grasp on four relational benchmarks spanning molecular toxicity prediction (Tox21), mutagenesis, and citation matching (Cora), and show that it improves over purely symbolic, neural, and LLM-based baselines, while producing interpretable weighted rule ensembles. By replacing combinatorial search with gradient-guided LLM hypothesis generation, grasp retains boosting guarantees without sacrificing the transparency of symbolic outputs.
papers.summary_en:
Language models can propose plausible logical rules, but those rules must still fit observed data. GRASP makes the LLM a proposal mechanism inside functional gradient boosting. A one-time stage invents aggregate predicates and a clause template. Each iteration supplies ten high-magnitude-residual training examples, their local relational descriptions, signed residuals and the current ensemble, requesting five candidate rules. Symbolic evaluation computes coverage; the mean residual among covered and uncovered examples supplies two separate leaf weights. The candidate with the lowest residual squared error joins the additive ensemble. Experiments use at most twenty boosting iterations and step size one. The LLM does not directly assign the fitted weights.

The evaluation actually covers three dataset families: Cora citation matching, Mutagenesis and twelve Tox21 targets, totaling fourteen tasks. Across the two GRASP variants, ten tasks have the highest mean ROC-AUC; PR-AUC has eleven strict wins and one tie. On Cora, the Codex variant reports 97.67% ROC-AUC versus 95.02% for BoostedRDN, a 2.65-percentage-point difference, not classification accuracy. Readable rules and insertion/deletion analysis expose influential rules, but do not establish human comprehensibility.

One-shot generation is not matched to twenty boosting rounds by proposal budget, so the gain cannot be assigned solely to residual-based example selection. Complete prompts, data splits and implementation code are not supplied. In Figure 2, the Gemini ensemble's log loss rises as more rules are inserted; this does not support a blanket claim of calibrated probabilities. Descent arguments require valid residual fitting and other conditions, and cannot guarantee global convergence for an arbitrary LLM oracle. The value is a general method for constraining LLM hypotheses through executable symbolic evaluation, not a validated medical decision system.
papers.summary_zh:
讓語言模型提出邏輯規則很容易，難的是讓規則真正符合資料。GRASP把大型語言模型放在梯度提升的「提案者」位置：先產生計數等聚合述詞及規則模板，每輪挑出十個殘差最大的訓練例，連同局部關係、殘差正負與現有規則提示模型，要求五個候選。符號求解器檢查規則覆蓋情況，分別用被覆蓋與未覆蓋例的平均殘差作兩個權重，再選誤差最小者加入加性集成；實驗最多二十輪、步長為一，權重不是由語言模型直接決定。

評估實際涵蓋Cora引用配對、致突變資料及Tox21十二個標的，共三類資料、十四項任務。兩種GRASP變體合計在十項任務有最高ROC曲線下面積；PR指標則十一項嚴格最佳，另有一項平手。Cora的Codex變體ROC為97.67%，BoostedRDN為95.02%，差2.65個百分點；這不是分類準確率。可讀規則和插入／刪除分析展現部分規則的重要性，但不等於人類理解已驗證。

限制也明顯：一次性生成與二十輪提升未配對相同提案預算，不能把增益全部歸因於殘差選例；完整提示、資料切分與程式未提供。圖二的Gemini集成隨規則加入，對數損失反而上升，無法支持全面校準良好。提升的下降性須有有效殘差擬合等條件，不能替任意語言模型提案保證全域收斂。價值在於以可執行符號評估約束語言模型的通用方法，而非已驗證的醫療決策工具。

llm_evaluation.rationale: This highly relevant, moderately novel empirical guardrail audit makes a concrete case that option names and lower-trust text can redirect decisions. Direction-separated errors, conditional ASR, label-invariance controls and equal-false-block-cost defenses are useful design choices. Scientific strength is limited by access-model and reporting details: the D5 adaptive attack writes retained fields outside the initial writable span, option attacks require separate control, and conditional ASR must not be mixed with overall fail-open. Escalation reduces 60.1% to 53.8% or 25.3%, supporting limited efficiency rather than no benefit. Persuasion is not monotonic in length, and the Table 4 selection description and ten-label budget numbers need clarification. Perfect deterministic rules apply to six deliberately parseable policies, not universal unattackability. Unverified external code limits reproducibility rather than completeness of the eighteen-page PDF. In scope for agent safety and evaluation methodology.

primary_link.title: One Word Opens the Gate: The Option-Channel Attack on Typed Decision Models as Agent Guardrails

papers.summary: A typed decision model reads a piece of text and returns a probability over caller-defined options, each with a short written definition, generating no text. Recent work places these models in agent systems as guardrails: the component that reads a proposed tool call or incoming message and decides whether to allow it. We evaluate seven open-weight models in that role and report the two error directions separately: a fail-open error allows a prohibited action and is a vulnerability; a fail-closed error blocks a permitted one and is only a cost. On prompt-injection, jailbreak and toxic-content screening, accuracy at the allow-or-block decision ranges from 36% to 72% against a chance level of 50%. A low error rate in one direction only reflects which answer a model defaults to: one allows nearly everything, another blocks nearly everything. On a synthetic suite of agent tool calls, six lines of server log text that say nothing about the policy raise a gate's fail-open rate from 0% to 63% on a policy it otherwise decides correctly. Giving the permissive option a misleading name, with its definition and the judged text untouched, raises that rate to between 93% and 100% on the four models that place the label in their input. Every defense we tested is defeated, either by an attacker who targets its mechanism or by attacker-controlled text. Escalating the least confident decisions does not help either: a decision an attack has reversed is no less confident than the one it replaced. Parsing each policy field into a typed value does eliminate one attack, but it also makes the model unnecessary: a deterministic rule over those values reaches 100% accuracy on all six policies. These models can reduce how many cases reach a reviewer, but on this evidence they should not be the component that decides. Code is available at this https URL.
papers.summary_en: Typed decision models return only option probabilities, making them easy to wire into an agent safety gate, but constrained output does not ensure sound decisions. The paper separates prohibited actions allowed from permitted actions blocked, studying five small decision models and two Qwen baselines without a fully crossed seven-model design. Accuracy on three balanced public screening datasets ranges from 36.4% to 71.7%, with different defaults toward allowing or blocking. GuardBench adds six policies whose answers follow explicit attributes. For LAYA-TD on an unauthorized-irreversible-action policy, six irrelevant log lines raise fail-open from zero to 63.3%. If a deployment lets external sources influence option names, renaming an option while preserving its definition and the judged text can change decisions sharply; implementations that omit names from model input are invariant to this channel. Defenses are compared at matched legitimate-traffic blocking cost, and low-confidence escalation has limited efficiency. Important qualifications are that some attack rates condition on initially correct blocks and that adaptive attacks on field defenses expand the writable surface beyond the original tool-output span. Escalation still improves some outcomes, and attack strength is not universally monotonic in text length. A deterministic rule achieves perfect results on the six synthetic policies, which reflects their construction rather than proving real systems unattackable. This is useful evidence about agent-guardrail trust boundaries, with the code repository only claimed in the paper and neither fetched nor reproduced here; commercial models and end-to-end agent security remain untested.
papers.summary_zh: 型別化決策模型只回傳選項機率，看似容易接成代理的安全閘門，但輸出格式受限不代表判斷可靠。本文將錯放違規操作與錯擋合法操作分開，檢查五種小型決策模型及兩種Qwen基線；各實驗並非七模型全交叉。在三個平衡公開篩選資料集上，準確率為36.4%至71.7%，不同模型偏向放行或阻擋。作者另建六項可由明確屬性計算答案的GuardBench：LAYA-TD原本不錯放的未授權不可逆操作，加六行無關日誌後錯放率達63.3%。若部署容許外部來源影響選項名稱，保持定義與待判文字不變也能大幅改判；不把名稱送入模型的實作則對此通道不變。研究比較同等合法流量誤擋成本下的防禦，並顯示低信心轉交審查效率有限。須注意，攻擊成功率有時只計原本正確阻擋的子集；針對欄位防禦的適應攻擊擴大了可寫位置，不能當原工具輸出權限下的突破。轉交審查仍有部分改善，日誌與說服文字也不全隨長度單調變強。結構化解析配確定性規則在六項合成政策達全對，是基準構造下的結果，並非真實系統不可攻破證明。本文適合思考代理護欄的信任邊界；程式庫僅在文中宣稱提供，本次未取得或重跑，商用模型與端到端代理安全亦未驗證。

primary_link.title: Recursive Self-Improvement through Multi-Agent Self-Supervision

papers.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of a model on non-verifiable tasks, such as open-ended research, faces a supervision bottleneck when its outputs exceed what even human experts can reliably assess, leaving the model itself (optimizee) as the best available optimizer and evaluator. However, a single model instance struggles to critique and improve its own complex reasoning under this homogeneous loop. To address this, we propose Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS), an RSI method that alternates between evolutionary workflow optimization and supervised fine-tuning on self-generated trajectories. Guided by early findings that multi-agent topologies excel at complex reasoning, MASS prompts a single base model to iteratively propose, execute, and self-evaluate multi-agent workflows. Through an evolutionary search constrained by structural guardrails, the model optimizes these computational-graph-like orchestrations, discovering the most effective distinct roles and information routing for a given task. Over two MASS cycles with Qwen3.6-27B, the model achieves 1.2-1.6x higher performance per output tokens on four open-ended public benchmarks. Because the improved model subsequently acts as a better optimizer and evaluator, this alternating framework enables a continuous, recursive bootstrapping of the model's capabilities. Moreover, multi-agent traces are also more training-efficient: a student trained on them outperforms a single-agent student trained on 1.4x more training tokens. These findings suggest that jointly learning orchestration and bounded subagent execution from multi-agent trajectories can provide an effective signal for RSI.
papers.summary_en: When one language model solves tasks, judges outputs and improves itself, shared biases can reinforce errors. MASS first searches multi-agent workflows, changing roles, output contracts and information routing, then fine-tunes shared weights on self-selected orchestrator and worker traces. Two rounds alternate these stages. The first round uses 119 trajectories from eight research-programming tasks, and evaluation removes the optimized workflow prompt. On three private tasks excluded from fine-tuning, the reported preference share against the original Qwen3.6-27B rises from 53.9% after one round to 69.9% after two. Four research benchmarks show reported score-per-output-token ratios of 1.2–1.6, while terminal operation and software repair benchmarks decline. The appendices materially qualify these results: MLR-Bench uses only 12 tasks; higher overall scores accompany increased paper delivery, task-level paired tests are nonsignificant, and average scores among delivered papers do not rise. Bare-prompt delegation becomes more common, but a generic team directive already elicits extensive handoffs from the base model, suggesting increased spontaneous use of existing capabilities. Training-token comparisons also differ in task coverage, sampling and checkpoint selection, so they do not establish lower total pipeline compute. One agent even changes the meaning of a simulation test yet receives favorable judgments, showing that coordination and judge preference do not guarantee scientific correctness. The contribution is a promising demonstration of joint workflow search and trace-based weight improvement, not evidence of indefinitely reliable general self-improvement. One backbone, two cycles and uninspected external code and records remain important limits.
papers.summary_zh: 當語言模型同時負責解題、評估與改進自己，錯誤可能在同一套偏見中循環。MASS先讓共享模型搜尋多代理工作流程，調整角色、交付契約與資訊傳遞，再以自身評選出的主控及子代理軌跡微調模型，交替執行兩輪。第一輪使用八項研究程式任務的119條軌跡；測試時拿掉最佳流程提示。Qwen3.6-27B在三項未參與微調的私有任務上，對原模型的評審勝率由53.9%升至69.9%；四個研究基準的每輸出token分數報告提升1.2–1.6倍，但一般終端操作及軟體修補基準下降。附錄讓結果更有層次：MLR-Bench只測十二題，總分上升伴隨交稿增加，逐題配對檢定不顯著；已交稿的平均分也未上升。模型在無額外提示時更常分工，但原模型收到通用分工指令就能大量交接，故較像學會主動運用既有能力。多代理訓練的token優勢另受任務數、採樣及檢查點選法混雜，不能等同整條流程省算力。尤其有代理改變模擬測試意義仍獲高評價，顯示協作與評審偏好不保證科學正確。本文值得關注的是自生軌跡與工作流程共同改進的可行性；單一骨幹、兩輪實驗及未取得的外部程式／紀錄，仍不足證明持續、可靠的通用自我提升。

llm_evaluation.rationale: UTT is a well-motivated, inspectable way to reuse teacher–student gap feedback as frozen-model context. The paper offers substantial full-pool improvements, cross-student transfer, true held-out subset evidence and useful component, quantization and multimodal analyses. Its empirical case is strongest as a practical prompting/teaching recipe. It is weaker as a claim of universal knowledge distillation: headline scores include synthesis-training problems, narrow margins against strong prompts lack uncertainty, and retained capabilities sometimes decline. Same-batch update validation is not an independent generalization guarantee. The frontier partition contains baseline failures, so renewed success may mix instruction gains with sampling/selection effects. Complete example Primers explicitly include output-format and token-budget tactics, as well as potentially inaccurate content; knowledge transfer is not isolated from these mechanisms. KD and API synthesis resource tables compare different stages and resource types, and the per-query input overhead remains. No replicated synthesis, code/run-record inspection or broad out-of-domain test establishes universal or permanent learning. In scope and worth reviewing, with no missing-PDF material hold.

primary_link.title: Universal Textual Teaching for LLMs

papers.summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from stronger Teacher models to weaker Student models, but most methods require training the Student parameters, thereby binding the distilled knowledge to a specific architecture and checkpoint. This implicit representation is difficult to interpret or reuse across models and limits KD for API-only or costly-to-train models. This paper studies knowledge transfer for large language models (LLMs). We introduce Universal Textual Teaching (UTT), a parameter-update-free framework that distills observed Teacher-Student knowledge gaps into a textual, interpretable, and reusable natural-language artifact called Primer. Specifically, UTT first identifies representative gap cases through paired evaluations, and iteratively updates the Primer via multi-role interactions: the Student attempts each task, the Prompter turns evaluation feedback into a teaching instruction, the Teacher provides a targeted demonstration, and the Synthesizer consolidates validated lessons. Empirically, on the challenging math (Omni-MATH-2) and code generation (KernelBench) tasks, extensive results confirm the effectiveness of the method: UTT remarkably raises the Student's accuracy from 9.4% to 48.6% and Fast1 accuracy from 9% to 35% on KernelBench, while increasing mathematical reasoning accuracy from 27.6% to 51.7%. UTT also performs better than representative prompt engineering and parameter-based KD methods. Of note, UTT is shown to be generalizable across different Teachers and Students: a Primer synthesized for one Teacher-Student pair can generalize to other Students that do not participate in the synthesis.
papers.summary_en: UTT aims to transfer knowledge without changing model weights by turning cases where a teacher outperforms a student into a reusable textual Primer. Paired evaluations identify gaps. After a student attempt, a Prompter diagnoses the failure, the Teacher demonstrates a solution and the Synthesizer revises the Primer. Only demonstrations passing evaluation are retained, and a candidate update is accepted when correctness on the same batch does not decrease. The resulting text is prepended at inference and can be reused by students absent from synthesis. In the Pro→Flash setting, reported KernelBench accuracy rises from9.4% to48.6% and math accuracy from27.6% to51.7%. These headline results, however, cover the full problem pool, including synthesis-training problems; they are not held-out-only scores. Split-wise results do support transfer: Pro→Qwen math improves from9.7% to64.8% on distillation-test problems, while two math retention subsets lose9.2 and14.2 percentage points. The appendices provide four role prompts, three complete Primers, ablations and preliminary quantization/multimodal transfers, making the mechanism inspectable. Removing the Prompter or update gate has subset-dependent tradeoffs. Superiority over strong prompting baselines is sometimes small: Qwen math improves only0.5 points over the best comparator, without uncertainty from repeated Primer synthesis. Fast1 means at least one of five samples is both correct and faster than the reference, not that every kernel speeds up. Text may contain errors, adds input cost on every task and is not covered by a fully comparable end-to-end cost analysis. This is useful evidence for cross-model contextual teaching, rather than universal knowledge transfer or permanent expansion of model capability.
papers.summary_zh: UTT嘗試不改模型權重，把教師較擅長、學生仍會犯錯的知識整理成可重用的文字教材Primer。它先配對評估師生，挑出能力差距題；學生作答後，由提示者診斷、教師示範、綜整者更新教材，只收通過評估的示範，並以當批正確數未下降作為更新條件。推論時把教材附在題目前，也可交給未參與製作的學生模型。Pro→Flash設定下，KernelBench正確率由9.4%升至48.6%，數學由27.6%升至51.7%；但這些醒目數字在完整題庫計算，包含教材合成用題，不能當成純留出測試。分割結果確實顯示轉移，例如Pro→Qwen數學差距測試題由9.7%升至64.8%，卻也有兩組既有能力保留題下降9.2及14.2個百分點。附錄提供四角色提示、三份教材、消融及跨量化／多模態初驗，讓方法容易理解；移除提示者或更新閘門的代價仍因子集而異。UTT對最強提示基線並非全面大幅領先，Qwen數學僅多0.5點，亦無重複合成的不確定性分析。Fast1是五次取一個正確且更快的kernel，非逐次速度提升。文字教材仍有錯誤風險與每次輸入成本，資源表也非端到端等價比較。這是有用的跨模型脈絡教學展示，尚不足證明通用知識轉移或永久擴張模型能力。

primary_link.title: An Investigation of Model Coherence: Narrow Finetunes Contradict Themselves Under Resampling

papers.summary: A large body of research measures model coherence based on output variance without adequately considering competing causes. We identify two such causes, ambiguity and indifference, and we introduce a set of 175 questions where contradicting answers cannot easily be explained by either. We then measure incoherence in terms of contradictions when resampling answers to the same question. In contrast to other methods our metric has high specificity, and only ranks models as incoherent when the issues are glaring. Even so, we find narrow finetunes score poorly. Inspecting inconsistencies flagged by our method, we find that model organisms from the literature display severe issues such as identity conflation, introspection failures and rationalizations. These findings suggest that the pathologies induced by narrow finetuning may limit what these models can tell us about coherent misaligned behaviour.
papers.summary_en: Different answers to repeated questions need not mean contradiction: ambiguity or indifference may also explain variation. The authors select 175 short questions intended to have clear, high-stakes or value-laden answers, sample each of 16 frontier models and 13 GPT-4.1 finetunes 20 times, and have a judge partition compatible responses. Partition entropy measures cross-response inconsistency. Frontier models average about 0.06 nats, versus about 0.89 for the insecure-code finetune, with qualitative examples of identity conflation, introspection failures and rationalization. More verbose reasoning in training responses only partly helps; mixing equal benign data into economics finetunes approaches baseline. Three shuffled judge passes, a second judge, synthetic truth and embedding clustering argue against a mere ordering artifact. A separate 20-question, three-framing test decomposes framing-associated and within-framing variation, with the latter dominant. However, exclusion of ambiguity and indifference remains author judgment. Low frontier scores do not empirically establish high specificity or certify safety/correctness. Both judges come from one model family and embeddings substantially over-cluster, so neither substitutes for independent human ground truth. Some of the most inconsistent finetunes also lose GSM8K accuracy; all finetunes share one base, and 20 samples miss rare responses. An appendix gives useful mathematical counterexamples to an earlier error-decomposition metric without proving that every form of coherence improves with scale. The practical lesson is to check behavioral stability before using narrowly misaligned models as safety-research stand-ins, not to infer inner goals or mechanisms from selected self-descriptions.
papers.summary_zh: 同一問題多問幾次，回答不同不一定代表模型自相矛盾，也可能是題意含糊或根本沒有偏好。本文挑選175道短而明確、涉及高風險或明確價值的題目，對16個前沿模型與13個GPT-4.1微調版本各抽樣20次，再由判官將相容回答分組，以分組熵衡量跨回答的不一致。前沿模型平均約0.06 nats，不安全程式微調約0.89；作者並展示身分混淆、內省失誤與合理化案例。增加訓練回答的推理與篇幅只能部分改善，經濟立場資料混入等量良性例子則接近基線。三次打亂重判、第二判官、合成真值與嵌入分群檢查，支持結果並非單純排序偶然。另以20題、三種提問框架拆分框架相關與同框架內變異，後者占主要部分。限制是題目是否排除歧義與冷漠仍靠作者判斷；低前沿分數不等已測得高特異度，更不認證安全或正確。兩判官同屬一個模型家族，嵌入又明顯過度分群，不能取代獨立真人真值。最不一致的部分微調亦降低GSM8K能力，且所有微調只來自一個基底；二十次抽樣會漏掉罕見反應。附錄對既有錯誤分解指標提出有用數學反例，但不證明所有一致性都隨規模改善。這項研究提醒使用失準模型作安全實驗替身時先檢查行為穩定性，尚不能由選出的自述推論內在目標或機制。

llm_evaluation.rationale: EvoAlloc turns candidate evaluation into a decision process that changes with search, using evidence-linked experiences, natural-language strategy and exploration of rejected candidates. A shared ShinkaEvolve configuration, five seeds, four comparators and fixed-strategy, no-exploration, random-allocation and explicit-feedback ablations support mean benefits on two testbeds; circle packing has no partial evaluator, so benefits are not solely early stopping. However, 59–82% evaluation and 61–89% token savings are conditional costs to the baseline final target, found after averaging trajectories. Exhausting the budget increases tokens by about 31%/78%, and acquiring 50 initialization cases is excluded, so end-to-end total cost reductions are not established. AIME uses the same 30 questions for search and evaluation; specialized examples and greater cross-seed variation limit generalization and robustness. Its 4.23 percentage-point gain is approximately 12% relative, not 12 points. Two-disagreement validation compares only local observed consequences, and all 21 adopted strategies won on evaluation counts, never fewer missed new-best cases. The exploration-feedback ablation retains indirect archive effects and is not a complete information-flow intervention. Two tasks, one allocator, no significance analysis or genuinely unseen evaluation, and no cross-run memory inheritance limit breadth. Public code remains a future promise. Its value is a transparent, testable design for allocating search budgets; end-to-end costs, unseen-problem generalization and cross-run strategy inheritance remain to be established.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: EvoAlloc把候選評估改為隨搜尋更新的決策問題，透過帶證據經驗、自然語言策略與被拒候選探索形成可檢驗閉環。共用ShinkaEvolve配置、五seed及四比較方法，加上固定策略、無探索、隨機配置與保留探索但移除明示回饋的消融，支持它在兩測試床的平均收益；Circle Packing沒有部分評估，顯示效果不限早停。然而59–82%評估與61–89% token節省是對基線最終目標、先平均後找達標點的條件結果；用滿預算token增加約31%／78%，初始化50案例取得成本另排除，不能轉述為端到端總成本下降。AIME共用30題搜尋與評估，題型特化範例及較高跨seed變異限制泛化與穩健性；增加4.23個百分點相當於約12%相對改善，不是12個百分點。兩歧見驗證僅比較局部已知後果，21次採納全因少用評估，未由較少漏失最佳案例決勝。探索回饋消融保留archive的間接影響，不能當完全切斷資訊的因果分解。只有兩任務、一個配置模型，無統計顯著性或真正未見測試、無跨次記憶繼承；公開程式仍待承諾實現。其價值是透明、可檢驗的搜尋預算調度設計；端到端成本、未見題泛化與跨次策略繼承仍需後續驗證。

primary_link.title: EvoAlloc: A Self-Evolving Resource Allocation Agent for Efficient Program Evolution

papers.summary: LLM-based program evolution relies on evaluation feedback to guide the iterative search for high-performing programs. However, evaluation is often computationally expensive, making it essential to allocate limited resources to candidates that can most effectively advance the search. Existing LLM-based methods typically rely on fixed allocation strategies throughout the search, potentially wasting resources on low-value candidates while overlooking promising ones. We propose EvoAlloc, a self-evolving resource-allocation agent that learns from search experience to revise its strategy for allocating computational resources across candidates. EvoAlloc periodically consolidates prior search and allocation outcomes into reusable experience, which informs subsequent strategy revisions. It further uses a counterfactual exploration mechanism to occasionally evaluate candidates denied resources by the allocator, revealing their outcomes to enrich its experience for future strategy updates. Across coding and agent-harness optimization benchmarks, EvoAlloc requires 59-82% fewer full evaluations and 61-89% fewer total LLM tokens to reach baseline-level performance. Moreover, under the same full-evaluation budget, EvoAlloc achieves 8.7-12.0% higher final performance.
papers.summary_en:
Program evolution produces many candidates, while evaluating each one fully can dominate its cost. EvoAlloc assigns evaluation decisions to an allocator with an evolving natural-language strategy. It consolidates outcomes into experiences, proposes a strategy revision every ten full outcomes, and compares incumbent and challenger on two disagreements with known outcomes. It also fully evaluates otherwise rejected candidates with probability 0.3, exposing counterevidence that selective filtering would hide.

Using the same ShinkaEvolve backbone and five independent seeds, final mean AIME harness accuracy rises from 35.33% to 39.56%, while the circle-packing score rises from 2.343 to 2.547. Reaching the baseline's final performance requires 59–82% fewer full evaluations and 61–89% fewer recorded model tokens. These figures locate a target after averaging trajectories; they do not mean every run achieves the same saving. Ablations removing strategy evolution, exploration or explicit exploration feedback support the roles of these mechanisms.

The cost boundary matters: exhausting the same full-evaluation budget instead increases total tokens by about 31% and 78%, and acquiring the fifty baseline initialization cases is excluded. AIME search and evaluation share the same thirty problems, with task-pattern-specific solvers among the examples, so unseen-problem generalization is unestablished. Only two tasks, five repetitions and substantial AIME variability limit extrapolation. Two-case validation does not guarantee overall strategy improvement, and code/configuration release is promised only upon acceptance. The contribution is a testable design for allocating evaluation budgets, rather than demonstrated general-purpose, autonomous self-improvement with lower total cost.
papers.summary_zh:
程式演化會產生大量候選，但逐一完整測試常是主要成本。EvoAlloc把「值得測誰」交給可更新自然語言策略的配置代理：整理歷次結果為經驗，每十次完整評估提出新策略，並以兩個已知結果的歧見案例比較；另以三成機率補測被拒候選，避免錯誤篩選永遠得不到反證。

在同一ShinkaEvolve骨架與五個隨機種子下，AIME推理程式的最終平均正確率由35.33%升至39.56%，圓形排列分數由2.343升至2.547。到達基線最終表現所需完整評估減少59–82%、模型token減少61–89%；這是先平均軌跡再找達標點，並非每次執行都能節省相同比例。移除策略演化、探索或探索回饋的消融支持各環節的作用。

成本界線尤其重要：用滿相同完整評估額度時，總token反而增加約31%與78%，且初始化五十個基線案例的取得成本未計入。AIME搜尋與評估共用三十題，範例包含題型特化解法，不能據此主張未見題泛化；僅兩個任務、五次重複及AIME較大變異也限制外推。兩案例驗證不保證整體策略改善，程式與設定僅承諾錄用後公開。本文的價值是可檢驗的評估預算調度設計，而非已證明通用、自主且更省總成本的自我改進。

llm_evaluation.rationale:
Overall: a relevant language-model distillation methodology worth considering in subsequent filtering. Its strength is an inspectable connection between token allocation and a real-optimizer one-step feedback signal, supported by ablations and diagnostics. Limits are one training seed, one model family, nearly doubled cost, adapted baselines, and the gap between relative diagnostic improvement and generalization. The six original rubric components follow.

0.92: The core contribution concerns language-model on-policy distillation, token-level supervision allocation, and mathematical-reasoning training, directly matching LLM, reasoning, optimization, and efficiency interests. This is methodological LLM research rather than a domain-only application, although no Japanese-language or agent/code-specific evidence is provided (§§3–4, pp.3–9).

0.70: Applying established bilevel meta-reweighting and Meta-Weight-Net ideas to OPD allocation on student-generated trajectories is a useful methodological combination. The 74-dimensional descriptor, response-mean constraint, and one-step hypergradient through the live AdamW state make the design concrete. Related work explicitly acknowledges prior bilevel weighting; meta-learning itself and the chain rule are not new theoretical inventions (§§2–3, Appendices A–B).

0.78: The mathematical boundaries are unusually explicit: virtual updates read without advancing moments, step counters, or the scheduler; the real step restarts from the original state. Descriptors are detached, while differentiation in eta retains score centering, response normalization, the global-clipping coefficient, and new first/second moments. The VJP–JVP expression equals the first derivative of the specified fixed-input single-step map; it is neither a first-order shortcut that discards optimizer derivatives nor a convergence guarantee. Sampled OPD is unbiased for the reverse-KL gradient only at theta=theta_old conditional on a fixed prefix. Training references may overlap rollouts and are not held-out generalization validation. Evaluation exclusion is author-reported, not independently audited from code/data. Train-only SFT calibration and same-architecture feature-subset controls help isolate the tested mechanism without ruling out every alternative supervision design (pp.3–7,13–20).

0.70: Table 1 provides coherent aggregate gains over seven baselines across two scales and six benchmarks: 17.96/35.91 versus 15.97/29.94 at 0.6B, and 27.32/46.82 versus 25.07/40.41 at 1.7B. Against the stronger TIP baseline, 1.7B gains narrow to 1.13/1.56 points; Minerva Avg@8 is slightly below OPD and AIME25 Pass@8 below TIP. Main and ablation runs share seed 42, three epochs, and 696 student steps, without multiple training seeds or main-table confidence intervals. Figure 1 uses three response-sampling seeds, not three complete training runs; diagnostic bootstrap intervals are conditional. In Table 12, Learned beats Uniform at three checkpoints but both increase loss relative to no update. Reweighted uses the same bank for allocation and scoring, so it is not independent test improvement. Several baselines transplant allocation rules into shared sampled OPD rather than reproduce the complete original algorithms. The 1.7B cost is 88.5 versus 45.0 GPU-hours without an equal-compute control (Tables 1,5,8–13; Appendices C–D).

0.60: Two student scales and three out-of-domain evaluations provide more breadth than a single math benchmark, but all models belong to Qwen3 with one 8B teacher and MATH training; only 1.7B is tested out of domain. GPQA and MMLU-Pro gains are limited, and AlpacaEval LC-WR is 15.98 versus 15.96, below TIP at 16.70. Table 2 averages five metrics, assigning GPQA/MMLU/Alpaca weights of 40/20/40 percent and mixing answer accuracy with preference scores; this is descriptive rather than a universal capability scale. Cross-family, larger-model, multilingual, and agent transfer remain untested, and local derivative correlations do not establish long-horizon generalization (Table 2, Appendices D–E).

0.61: The 26-page PDF, including Appendices A–E, supplies an algorithm, the 74–256–64–1 network, weight bounds, EOS mapping, global token reduction, baseline settings, training steps, resources, and bootstrap protocols, supporting core-method review. Page 10 promises code and configurations with release; they were not acquired or executed here. Availability and computational reproducibility are therefore unverified, but absent external code does not itself establish a missing core-method supplement. Exact package/optimizer configuration and execution artifacts were not audited; costs cover only 1.7B and exclude evaluation/diagnostics. A SHA-shaped ETag differs from the retained-body SHA and no authenticated checksum is available. This remains a transport/provenance caveat, not evidence of scientific misconduct (p.10, Appendices A–E).

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
總評：值得納入後續篩選的語言模型蒸餾方法研究。優點是把詞元價值接到可檢查的實際optimizer單步回饋，並以消融與診斷支持配權；限制集中在單種子、單模型家族、近兩倍成本、基線改寫，以及診斷相對改善與泛化的距離。原六項規準逐項如下。

0.92：核心是語言模型的on-policy蒸餾、詞元層級監督分配與數學推理訓練，直接符合大型語言模型、推理、訓練最佳化及效率偏好。不是把一般領域應用包裝為LLM方法；但沒有日本語或代理／程式任務的專門證據（§3–4，頁3–9）。

0.70：把既有雙層meta-reweighting／Meta-Weight-Net原理具體化為學生自行生成軌跡的OPD配權，是有用的組合與實作貢獻；74維描述子、逐回答均值限制，以及保留真實AdamW狀態的單步超梯度使設計清楚。相關工作已承認雙層資料配權先例，不能將meta-learning本身或鏈式法則當全新理論（§2–3，附錄A–B）。

0.78：數學界線交代扎實：虛擬更新讀取而不推進原moments、步數與scheduler，真正更新重返原狀態；特徵detach，但η方向仍微分score centering、response normalization、global clipping係數與新一二階動量。VJP–JVP等價的是固定輸入之指定單步的一階導數，並非忽略optimizer導數的first-order近似或全程收斂保證。sampled OPD也只在θ=θold、固定prefix處對reverse-KL梯度無偏。外層reference屬train且允許重疊，不能稱held-out泛化驗證。作者排除evaluation更新的聲明沒有由外部資料／程式獨立查核。SFT係數在train校準及同架構特徵子集對照有助隔離機制，但不是所有替代配權／監督設計的否證（頁3–7、13–20）。

primary_link.title: MetaOPD: Meta-Learned Token Weighting for On-Policy Distillation

papers.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generated responses using token-level teacher supervision. However, uniform weighting overlooks differences in token learning value, while existing weighting methods rely on predefined mappings from prediction signals to token weights. These mappings are not learned from the effectiveness of the resulting student updates, limiting their ability to adapt to evolving learning needs. In this paper, we propose MetaOPD, a bilevel optimization framework that jointly learns the student model and a lightweight token-weighting network. The inner objective updates the student through weighted OPD, while the outer objective optimizes the weighting network using validation loss on reference solutions after a virtual student update. Differentiating through this update connects weighting decisions to their effects on post-update performance, allowing the mapping from prediction signals to token weights to evolve alongside the student. Experiments on six mathematical reasoning and three out-of-domain datasets, covering two student scales and seven baselines, demonstrate the effectiveness of MetaOPD, with Avg@8/Pass@8 gains over OPD of 1.99/5.97 percentage points for the 0.6B student and 2.25/6.41 points for the 1.7B student.
papers.summary_en:
MetaOPD asks how small language models can learn more effectively from teacher supervision on their own generated trajectories. Fixed entropy- or disagreement-based weights need not reflect actual learning gains. A small network instead maps 74-dimensional token descriptors to weights with unit mean within each response. Each iteration reads the current student AdamW state for an uncommitted virtual update, learns the weighting network from reference-solution loss, and then performs the real update from the original state. The references come from MATH training data and may overlap the rollout prompts; they are not a separate held-out meta-validation pool. The authors state that evaluation examples do not update either network.

With Qwen3-8B teaching 0.6B and 1.7B students, the six-math-benchmark Avg@8/Pass@8 averages improve over OPD by 1.99/5.97 and 2.25/6.41 percentage points, respectively. Avg@8 averages correctness across eight responses; Pass@8 counts problems with at least one correct response. Restricted-feature and direct-SFT controls support this allocation approach, but the main results use one training seed and several baselines are adapted to a shared surrogate loss. The 1.7B training run costs approximately 1.97 times OPD, so this is not an equal-compute advantage.

The derivation retains normalization, clipping, and new AdamW-moment derivatives, establishing gradient equality only for the specified single-step map. In checkpoint diagnostics, learned weights outperform uniform weights relatively while both can raise absolute loss; the additional reweighting intervention also reuses its evaluation bank. Out-of-domain gains vary, and the promised code was not obtained for this review. The value is an inspectable supervision-allocation method, rather than a guarantee of long-horizon convergence or universal gains.
papers.summary_zh:
MetaOPD研究小型語言模型如何從自己的生成軌跡，更有效地吸收教師監督。固定依熵或分歧配權未必對應真正學習收益；作者改以小型網路讀取74維詞元特徵，學習每個回答內均值為一的權重。每次先借用學生目前的AdamW狀態做不提交的虛擬更新，再用參考解答損失訓練配權網路，最後從原狀態執行真正更新。參考解答取自MATH訓練集，與生成提示可重疊，並不是獨立保留驗證集；作者表示評測資料不參與更新。

以Qwen3-8B教導0.6B與1.7B學生，六項數學測試的Avg@8／Pass@8平均較OPD分別增加1.99／5.97及2.25／6.41個百分點。前者衡量八次回答的平均正確率，後者是至少答對一次的題目比例。特徵子集與直接加入SFT的對照支持此配權方式，但主結果只有一個訓練種子，部分基線也改用共同代理損失。1.7B訓練成本約為OPD的1.97倍，不能直接視為等算力優勢。

推導保留正規化、裁切與AdamW的新動量導數，僅保證指定單步的梯度等價。診斷中學得權重雖優於均勻權重，兩者仍可能提高絕對損失；重配權又使用同一評估資料。域外改善並不一致，程式碼尚未實際取得。本文值得關注的是可檢查的監督分配方法，而非長期收斂或普遍增益保證。

llm_evaluation.rationale:
Memento 3 offers a relevant, inspectable learning loop for a frozen-LLM agent: record environment hypotheses in language, compile code, reflect on counterexamples and use accepted models to guide further exploration. Its value lies in separating semantic rule revision from implementation repair. It integrates established world-model, reflective-memory and replay-verification ideas rather than recursively improving the language model’s weights.

The strongest evidence is completion of 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games with per-game action accounting: 7,518/17,135 is approximately 43.87%, and approximately 9.93% fewer actions than baseline1, which also completes every game. RHAE combines level-index weighting, squared human/agent action ratios and clipping; 100 does not mean optimal performance on each level or general intelligence. Leaderboard systems are not fully matched for backbone, reasoning budget or total compute. In particular, the 59.3-point difference from the Standard harness is not a controlled effect of architecture alone. The three-game ablation supports a local improvement, without repeated trials or uncertainty estimates.

Exact replay eliminates models inconsistent with observed history; it does not certify unseen-state predictions, inferred goals or the LLM’s semantic judgment. Reducing actions from 899 to 597 with two models on wa30 is one comparison, not evidence of reduced across-run variance, and level 8 uses more actions. Three 21:0 Pong episodes with different openings demonstrate a fixed controller, but learning stops at a first perfect win, seeds and opponent settings are incompletely specified, and full-frame replay retains errors. Zero evaluation-time LLM calls must be separated from LLM-dependent learning; 9,504 learning frames versus RL baselines is not an equal-total-cost or equal-protocol comparison. Incomplete reconstructable materials, absent hidden tests and missing total inference/planning costs limit reproducibility and extrapolation.
